v: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”
b: This verse reminds us that when facing hardship and challenge, we should meet it with praise and a holy heart. Jehoshaphat's army put on holy array and, before the battle, chose to worship God to express their trust in and gratitude to Him. It was an act of faith, showing that they believed God's lovingkindness and power would protect and lead them.

It is like a musician who, before going on stage, carefully puts on his best formal wear and adjusts every detail, because he wants to give his best performance in the most perfect state. In the same way, when we face the various challenges of life, we should prepare ourselves with the most holy attitude and meet every “battle” with faith and praise.

A brother named Chen Qiang faced a major challenge at work. His company went through a large-scale restructuring, and many colleagues lost their jobs. Chen Qiang knew that he too faced an uncertain future, but he chose to face each day with a heart of gratitude and praise, praying quietly before each day began and entrusting everything to God. In the end he not only kept his job but was promoted for his positive attitude and excellent performance in the difficulty.
Chen Qiang's testimony tells us that when we face life's challenges with praise and a holy attitude, God will protect us and lead us to victory with His lovingkindness and power.

Dear family, let us remember that when we face any challenge, we should put on holy “array” and meet every spiritual battle with praise and thanksgiving. Believe in God's lovingkindness and power; He will open the way for us.
ah: This verse reminds us that worship and praise are important expressions of our response to God's holiness, and we should take part in worship with an attitude of respect. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Prepare for Worship
Before taking part in worship at church, spend time preparing your heart, whether reading Scripture, praying silently, or listening to hymns, so that your heart is fully focused on God's holiness.
Dress and Appearance
When attending worship or spiritual gatherings, pay attention to your clothing and appearance and choose suitable and modest dress. This expresses your reverence and respect for God.
Write Worship Songs
If you have musical or writing talent, try writing or composing worship songs. This is not only praise to God but also a way of offering your talent to Him.
Family Worship
Hold family worship regularly at home, whether on a weekend morning or an evening, inviting the family to sing praises together. This makes your home an altar of praise to God.
Join the Worship Team
If you feel called, consider joining the church's worship team, whether as a song leader, accompanist, or technical support. This is a way of practicing worship through service.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the opportunity to worship and praise. Help us prepare for and take part in every worship with devout hearts, so that our lives may become a hymn of praise that never ceases. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you meet every challenge each day of your life with a holy attitude and a voice of praise, and gain victory in God's lovingkindness. Amen!

v: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
b: This verse reminds us that when we come before God to worship, we need a holiness that is the same inside and out. Holy adornment is not only outward beauty but the expression of a sincere and reverent heart. Our worship should be a total offering, giving God our best and honoring His name with a holy attitude.

It is like a bride who dresses carefully on her wedding day, putting on the most beautiful gown, because on this most important day she wants to show her beauty to the one she loves. In the same way, every time we come before God, we should be like a bride, bringing our most holy and beautiful heart to offer our worship to Him.

A sister named Li Hua pays great attention to the holiness of her heart. Before every Sunday worship she spends time examining herself before God, clearing away stray thoughts from her heart, and asking God in prayer to cleanse it. She believes that only inner holiness can make her worship acceptable to God. This preparation lets her truly sense God's presence in every worship, and her life has become more peaceful and joyful because of it.
Li Hua's testimony tells us that when we worship God with a holy heart, our worship is not only accepted by God but also brings peace and joy to the heart.

Dear family, let us remember that when we come before God to worship, we should come with a holy heart and give Him the glory due to Him. Let us offer God our best worship with a holiness that is the same inside and out.
ah: This verse reminds us that in worship we should glorify God in the best way, and both our inner preparation and our outward expression should reflect our reverence for Him. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Cleansing the Heart
Spend time each day in self-reflection and repentance, bringing the negative emotions and sins of your heart before God. This makes your heart purer in worship.
Bring an Offering
Prepare a special offering each week, whether money, time, or talent, and give it to the work of God. This is a way of responding to God's grace through action.
A Tidy Place of Worship
When taking part in church activities or family worship, make sure the place of worship is tidy and orderly. This expresses the importance you give to worship and your reverence for God.
Decorate a Family Altar
Set up a simple but meaningful altar at home, with a cross, a Bible, or spiritual books. Such an arrangement can help you focus on God's holiness in worship.
Music and Prayer
Choose suitable worship music and prayer content and arrange the order of worship beforehand. This ensures that the quality and substance of every worship truly glorifies God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for helping us understand that in worship we should glorify You with our best. Help us in every worship to worship You with a clean heart and fitting conduct. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you come before God in holy array at every worship, and experience abundant grace in His presence. Amen!

v: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
b: This verse reminds us that holy incense symbolizes the worship and prayer we offer to God. These should be pure and undefiled, like carefully prepared incense with a rich fragrance that rises straight to God's throne. Our prayer and worship should also come from the heart, with a holy attitude, so that God may accept them.

It is like a cook preparing a delicacy, carefully choosing each seasoning to make sure the final flavor is perfect, so that one taste amazes. In the same way, our prayer and worship should be carefully “blended” by the heart, offered with holiness and focus, so that they become incense that pleases God.

A sister named Zheng Yali pays great attention to holiness in her prayer life. Before each prayer she first clears her heart of stray thoughts and prepares her spirit with hymns of worship, so that she can enter fully into fellowship with God. She believes that only when her heart is clean can her prayer be accepted by God like a sweet fragrance. This prayer life has made her spiritual life keep growing and has enabled her to keep feeling God's presence and comfort in hardship.
Yali's testimony tells us that when we pray with a holy heart, our prayer is like fragrance rising straight to God's throne and is accepted by Him.
Dear family, let us remember that our prayers should be holy, like a carefully blended incense, offering our worship and petitions to God with holiness and purity.
ah: This verse reminds us that every detail of worship should be holy, and just as incense is made with great care, our conduct and attitude should be blameless. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Keep Your Speech Holy

In daily conversation, pay attention to whether your speech is pure and upright, and avoid saying anything hurtful or inappropriate. In this way you are like a believer giving off the fragrance of holiness.
Serve Wholeheartedly
Whether small matters at home or church ministry, do each thing with all your heart and strength. This attitude is offering God “pure and holy incense.”
Live with Self-Control
In eating, entertainment, spending, and so on, learn self-control and avoid excess. In this way your life can give off a holy fragrance like carefully blended incense.
Care for Others

In dealing with people, learn to observe and care about the needs of others, whether family, friends, or strangers, and take the initiative to help. In this way your conduct becomes “holy incense” in God's eyes.
Uphold Justice
In society or at work, be brave enough to stand up for justice and support those who need help. In this way you can give off the fragrance of God's justice and holiness in society.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us how to be a witness of Your holy incense in our lives. Help us keep holy in word and deed and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you always come before God with a holy heart in prayer and worship, and find satisfaction and comfort in His presence. Amen!

v: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.
b: This verse reminds us that serving God needs not only faith and love but also a heart of holiness and righteousness. Our service should be fearless, completing the mission God has entrusted to us with a holy heart, in complete trust in God. Such service is accepted by God and becomes part of His kingdom.

It is like a writer who carefully writes a book, weighing every sentence, removing unnecessary flourishes, and keeping what truly touches the heart. In the same way, when serving God we should remove every distracting thought and serve wholeheartedly in holiness and righteousness, so that our service, like that book, can move hearts and become a beautiful witness in God's eyes.

A brother named Li Zhiming has served in the church for many years. Whether teaching or ministering, he gives himself wholeheartedly and always keeps a holy heart. In the course of his service he has met many challenges and difficulties, but he persevered in prayer and always held himself to the standard of holiness and righteousness. In the end his service was not only affirmed by the church but also made him a spiritual example to many.
Li Zhiming's testimony tells us that when we serve God with a holy heart, our service will bear beautiful fruit and our lives will be richer for it.

Dear family, let us remember that in serving God we should take holiness and righteousness as the standard, fearlessly complete what God has entrusted to us, and in the process experience God's presence and blessing.
ah: This verse reminds us that we should serve God with a heart of holiness and righteousness, and live before Him boldly and without fear every day. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Daily Devotional Time
Set a fixed time for devotions each day, reading Scripture, praying, and meditating on God's word. This lets your heart be full of holiness and righteousness in serving God.
Live Out a Testimony of Righteousness
At work or at school, whatever injustice or temptation you face, insist on acting by God's standard of righteousness. In this way you can live out a real testimony of faith before others.
Take the Initiative to Serve Others

Plan one active act of serving others each week, whether visiting a lonely elder, joining volunteer work, or helping a friend in difficulty. In this way you can practice service in holiness and righteousness.
Keep Peace in Your Heart
Whatever challenge or difficulty you face, entrust everything to God through prayer and keep your heart at peace and unafraid. In this way you can live before Him without fear as you serve.
Serve with a Holy Heart
In taking part in church ministry, keep pure motives and attitudes, not seeking fame or praise, but serving only for God's glory. In this way you can serve Him with a holy heart.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us how to serve You in holiness and righteousness. Help us live before You boldly and without fear every day, and glorify You with our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you come before God with a holy heart in every act of service and bear abundant fruit in His kingdom. Amen!

v: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.
b: This verse reminds us that God's law is not a bondage on our lives but a standard of holiness God has given us, guiding us on the path of uprightness, righteousness, and goodness. When we keep God's law, we are not only following God's heart but also pursuing spiritual holiness, so that our lives reflect God's character.

It is like a precise watchmaker who relies on a standard timetable to adjust every part, making sure every gear turns accurately. In the same way, God's law is like the standard in our lives, enabling us to walk accurately in His will and avoid going in the wrong direction or straying from the path.

A sister named Wang Li began to study God's word when she was young and worked to obey it in daily life. When she met difficulties and challenges, she often recalled God's law and made it the guide for how she lived. Once she faced a moral dilemma at work, and many people advised her to compromise for her own interest, but she chose to follow God's law and hold to the principles of honesty and integrity. In the end she not only kept her position but also won the respect of her boss and colleagues because of her integrity.

Wang Li's testimony tells us that when we keep God's law, these holy commandments will guide us onto the right path, and however hard the outside circumstances, we can find peace and strength in them.

Dear family, let us remember that God's law is holy, righteous, and good. It is the guide to our lives, leading us on the path of uprightness. When we keep this law, our lives will reflect God's holiness, and in the process we will experience His grace and protection.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's law is holy and His commandments are righteous and good. We should weave these truths into our lives to become the guide of our conduct. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Daily Bible Reflection

Spend time each day reading Scripture and meditating on its commandments and teaching, and think about how to apply these truths in your own life. This helps you live out God's righteousness and goodness in every decision.
Keep the Commandments

When you meet challenges or temptations in life, remind yourself at all times to keep God's commandments, whether in how you treat others or your attitude toward work. In this way you can live out a holy witness.
Establish Moral Standards
In your family, workplace, or school, set and hold to high moral standards and lead by example. This can influence others to walk the path of holiness too.
Pass On Goodness
At least once a week, take the initiative to show kindness to family, friends, or strangers. This lets you practice God's goodness in life and become a channel of blessing.
Pray for Wisdom
Before every major decision, first pray to God for wisdom. This helps you hold to righteousness in difficulty and keep your heart holy.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us Your holy law and commandments. Help us weave these truths into every decision of our lives, so that our conduct may reflect Your righteousness and goodness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold on to God's law every day, and let His holiness be strength and guidance in your life. Amen!

v: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’
b: This verse reminds us that God's grace is holy and sure, because in Christ He has prepared redemption for us, so that we are no longer held captive by corruption but can enter the glory of eternal life. This grace is a priceless gift. Each of us has received God's love and grace, which enables us to live out our faith powerfully in daily life and experience God's presence.

It is like a father who prepares a rich inheritance for his child, not only to meet the child's material needs but also in the hope that the child will understand the love and expectation behind that inheritance. In the same way, the grace God has prepared for us is not only spiritual provision but also something He wants us to grow in and use to glorify His name.

A brother named Lin Zhong once suffered a major setback in his career and nearly lost everything. But at his lowest point he returned to God and deeply felt that God's grace was still upon him. After prayer and reflection he decided to start over, and in his new business he relied even more on God's guidance. In the end his efforts were rewarded and his business gradually got on track. He knows that all of this is the work of God's holy grace and not his own strength.
Lin Zhong's testimony tells us that when we understand and accept God's holy grace, this grace not only saves us from difficulty but also gives us strength to meet new challenges.
Dear family, let us remember that God's grace is holy and sure. This grace gives us strength to rely on Him in every challenge and be renewed in His love.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's grace is holy and sure, an infinitely precious gift in our lives. We should respond to this grace with thankful hearts and show it in our daily conduct. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Gratitude Journal
Write down at least three things each day in which you sense God's grace. This helps you give thanks often and reminds you how His grace continually fills your life.
Give Your Time

Set aside time each week to take part in church or community ministry, whether caring for the vulnerable, volunteering, or helping those in need. In this way you can share with others the grace God has given you.
Share Grace with Others
In daily life, when someone asks about the source of your joy and peace, boldly share what God has done in your life. This lets more people realize how precious God's grace is.
Thankful Prayer
Spend time each day in prayer thanking God for all the grace He has given you. This keeps your heart relying on and trusting God at all times.
Live Out Grace

In dealing with people, especially in hardship and challenge, remember God's grace and reflect it, whether by forgiving others or by giving others a chance. This fills your life with God's holiness and grace.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us holy and sure grace. Help us respond to this grace with thankful hearts and live it out, so that we become witnesses of Your grace. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's holy grace every day, and with that grace as your strength walk the path of faith and hope. Amen!

v: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
b: This verse reminds us that our being chosen by God comes from His love and grace, and the purpose of this choosing is to make us holy through the Spirit and obedient to the will of Jesus Christ. Our lives are thus marked as belonging to God, kept and guided by Him.

It is like a sculptor who carefully selects a fine piece of marble and, through polishing and carving, at last makes the stone into an exquisite work of art. In the same way, God has chosen us, and through the work of the Holy Spirit He keeps carving and trimming our lives so that we may become holy vessels that please Him.

A sister named Li Xiaohua grew up in the faith, but only as an adult did she truly understand the meaning of being chosen to be holy. After a major upheaval in her life she began to pray and study the Bible more deeply, and under the Spirit's guidance her faith became firmer and purer. She came to understand that God's choosing her did not mean avoiding difficulty but relying on God all the more in difficulty and becoming more holy because of it.

Xiaohua's testimony tells us that when we realize we have been chosen by God, our lives are filled with strength and meaning, and we will work harder to pursue holiness and live a life that pleases God.

Dear family, let us remember that we are chosen to be His holy people, a privilege and responsibility in our lives. Under the Spirit's guidance, may we work to pursue holiness and respond to God's love with obedient hearts.
ah: This verse reminds us that becoming holy is God's calling for us, accomplished through the Spirit's guidance and Jesus Christ's redemption. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Prayer Led by the Spirit
Spend time praying each day, asking the Holy Spirit to guide your day and help you pursue holiness in every decision and action. This keeps you intimately connected to God at all times.
A Daily Check on Obedience
At the end of the day, spend a few minutes reflecting on your conduct and ask yourself whether you obeyed God in every area. Such self-examination helps you grow and keep pursuing holiness.
Support in Community
Join or form a faith group in which you share with and support one another, especially in the challenges of the life of faith. Such community life keeps you from being alone on the road to holiness.
Practice Love and Obedience
In daily life, whether at home, at work, or in the community, take the initiative to treat others with love and obedience. This reflects your obedience to and love for God.
Proclaim Redemption

Boldly declare, on suitable occasions, the change you have received through Christ's redemption, whether through testimony, sharing, or action. This lets more people know God's grace and the power of redemption.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing us to be holy and accomplishing all this through the Holy Spirit and the redemption of Jesus Christ. Help us obey Your leading in daily life and live a holy life. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out a holy life every day in your identity as one chosen, and find satisfaction in God's grace and peace. Amen!

v: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
b: This verse reminds us that God's discipline is not meant to punish us but for our benefit, so that we may share in His holiness. It is an expression of God's love for us; He hopes that we will keep growing in life and become more and more like Him.

It is like a responsible teacher who, in teaching students, corrects their mistakes at the right time to help them master knowledge and skills better. These corrections may make students uncomfortable at the time but bring greater gains in the end. In the same way, God's discipline may make us feel pain, but all of it is to bring us closer to His holiness.

A brother named Lin Wenzhong went through many challenges and trials in the early days of his faith. He once complained about these difficulties and felt that God's discipline was too harsh. But as time passed he gradually understood that these trials were exactly how God wanted him to grow in faith and share in His holiness. Today his life is full of spiritual wisdom and strength, and he understands that all of it is God's grace.
Wenzhong's testimony tells us that God's discipline is not meant to strike us down but for our benefit, so that we grow in His holiness.

Dear family, let us remember that God's discipline is an important part of the growth of our spiritual lives. Let us accept His guidance with thankful hearts and, in the process, keep pursuing holiness and become more and more like our Heavenly Father.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's discipline is for our benefit, so that we may share in His holiness. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Accept God's Discipline
When facing a challenge or trial, do not rush to complain or escape, but quietly consider whether this is God's discipline, and ask God to help you learn and grow from it.
Practice Repentance
Examine yourself regularly, recognize where you have strayed from God's way, and be willing to repent. In this way you can grow better under God's discipline.
Wait Patiently for the Result
Believe that God's discipline will in the end bring benefit. However difficult the present situation, be patient and look forward to the result of God's work in your life.
Teach Others

After you have experienced God's discipline and learned lessons from it, share your experience and what you learned with others, especially those going through similar challenges. In this way you can be an encouragement and help to them.
Cultivate a Thankful Heart
In good times and bad, learn gratitude, especially when you experience God's discipline. Such gratitude helps you accept it better and benefit from it.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for benefiting us through Your discipline. Help us see Your heart in every challenge and be willing to accept Your guidance, so that we share in Your holiness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you accept God's discipline every day, grow into a more holy child of God because of it, and enjoy abundant life in His grace. Amen!

v: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
b: This verse reminds us that Christ's sacrifice was not only to redeem our souls but also to make us holy people who can stand before God without blemish. This is God's great grace to us. Because of Christ's sacrifice we are saved from sin and enter a holy life.

It is like an artist who carefully carves a rough stone and at last turns it into a perfect work of art. In the same way, Christ's sacrifice is to rescue us from the roughness of sin and make us a holy people without blemish before God.

A sister named Chen Jiali was lost in the temptations of the world in her youth, but when she met Jesus her life was completely changed. She not only gave up her former unholy conduct but also began to take an active part in church ministry and gave her life to God. Today she has not only matured spiritually but has also become a spiritual mentor to many sisters, helping them walk the path of holiness.
Jiali's testimony tells us that Christ's sacrifice has opened a way of holiness for us. We need only walk on this road in faith, and we can be a people without blemish before God.

Dear family, let us remember that Christ's sacrifice has made us holy, and our lives have been made clean by His grace. May we each day walk the path of holiness by His strength and be accepted by Him before God.
ah: This verse reminds us that through His sacrifice Christ has made us holy, without blemish, and blameless before God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Remember Christ's Sacrifice
Spend time each day meditating on the price Christ paid for us. This helps us always remember our holy identity and be more careful in how we live.
Keep a Clean Heart
Avoid anything that might defile your heart, whether media, entertainment, or relationships. This ensures you stay blameless before God.
Live a Reconciled Life
In your family and relationships, actively seek reconciliation and restoration, especially in broken relationships or disputes. This reflects how Christ reconciled us to Himself.
Take Part in Communion
Each time you take communion, come with reverence and gratitude and reaffirm your identity in Christ. This lets you experience God's love and holiness more deeply.
Pray for Others
Pray for those who have not yet been reconciled to God, and at suitable opportunities witness to them of God's love. In this way you can be a blessing and a help in their lives.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us holy through the sacrifice of Christ. Help us live a life without blemish and blameless, and be willing every day to remember and respond to Your love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be made holy through Christ's redemption every day, and glorify God with a life without blemish. Amen!

v: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
b: This verse is full of rich teaching about the many roles Christ plays in our lives. Christ is not only our Savior; He has also become our wisdom, righteousness, holiness, and redemption. When we receive Christ, our lives are bound closely to His character, and we can find a firm direction in this confused world.

Like an experienced mentor who offers wisdom and guidance amid confusion and challenge, Christ is our supreme teacher whenever we face the challenges of life. His wisdom helps us make the right choice in complicated decisions, His righteousness leads us along a fair and upright path, His holiness makes our lives purer, and His redemption gives us eternal hope.

There was a brother named Li Wei who, in the low point of his life, fell into confusion and could not find his way. He was facing serious financial difficulty, his career had hit a bottleneck, and even his family relationships were beginning to break down. In despair, he decided to come to church and seek God's help anew. As he grew in faith, he found that he was growing not only in wisdom but, more importantly, that in Christ he had found inner peace and strength. In the end, Li Wei not only overcame his financial troubles but also restored his family relationships and found a new direction in his work.
Li Wei's story shows us that when we entrust our lives to Christ, He becomes our wisdom, righteousness, holiness, and redemption, so that we can stand firm no matter what challenges we face.

Dear family, let us remember that Christ is everything in our lives. He gives us wisdom to handle life's complexities, righteousness to guide our conduct, holiness to cleanse our hearts, and redemption to secure our eternal destiny. May we rely on Christ every day and let Him work in our lives, so that we become witnesses to His glory.
ah: This verse reminds us that in Christ Jesus we have received God's wisdom, righteousness, holiness, and redemption. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Wise Choices

Whenever you make a choice, especially a major decision, first ask God for His wisdom, and let every decision reflect God's righteousness and holiness, so that you can live a life consistent with Christ.
Righteous Conduct
When you face injustice, choose to stand up and speak words of justice and do what is right, whether at work, in your community, or at home, so that you can be a witness to righteousness.
A Holy Life
In daily life, keep your thoughts and actions pure, and stay far from sin and temptation, so that Christ's holiness can be displayed in you.
Gratitude for Redemption
Thank God every day for the redemption He has given you in Christ. Such gratitude will help you treasure your new life in Christ and live a life worthy of this salvation.
Sharing Salvation
When you have the opportunity, boldly share the salvation you have received with others, whether friends, family, or strangers, so that you can be a messenger of God's redeeming grace.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us wisdom, righteousness, holiness, and redemption through Christ Jesus. Please help us live out these godly qualities in our daily lives and be Your witnesses. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience Christ's wisdom, righteousness, holiness, and redemption every day, and find true peace and joy in Him. Amen!

v: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
b: This verse reveals an awe-inspiring truth: before the world was created, God had already chosen us in Christ, and His purpose was that we would be a holy people, without blemish, before Him. What great grace this is! God's choosing was not because of our good deeds or merits, but because of His unconditional love and mercy.

It is like a mother who loves her child and makes plans for his future even before he is born. That love is so deep and lasting that it does not depend on the child's performance, but on the mother's boundless love for her child. In the same way, God chose us before the creation of the world. He loves us and is willing to accomplish His beautiful plan in our lives.

There was a brother named Lin Zhi who had experienced many failures and setbacks growing up, and he often felt he did not deserve love and blessing. But when he realized that God's choosing did not depend on his past or his failures, but was based on God's unconditional love, his life began to change. He was no longer ashamed of past mistakes, but thanked God for His grace and worked to live a holy life in response to God's choosing of him.

Lin Zhi's story reminds us that the life of every believer is specially chosen by God. No matter what our past has been, God is willing to make us holy and without blemish in Christ. This is something we should treasure and be thankful for.

Dear family, let us remember that God chose us in Christ to be holy and without blemish. This is proof of His love and grace toward us. May we strive every day to live out this holy life, to glorify God, and to give thanks for His choosing.
ah: This verse reminds us that before the foundation of the world God chose us to be holy and without blemish before Him. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Morning Meditation
Each morning when you wake, spend a few minutes meditating on the fact that God chose you before creation. This will help you begin the day with gratitude and remind you to live a holy life.
Priorities
Set spiritual priorities in daily life, and let your actions and decisions reflect God's choosing and your identity as a holy person.
Acts of Love
Treat the people around you with selfless love, especially those who are hard to love. Such actions reflect God's love and His desire for you to be holy and blameless.
Keep Your Thoughts Pure
In your choices of entertainment and media, choose content that helps keep your thoughts pure, so that you may be without blemish before God.
Daily Self-Examination
Each evening, reflect on whether you lived out the holy identity God chose for you that day. In this way you can keep growing and correct your behavior.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing us before the creation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before You. Please help us live out this holy identity each day and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's choosing and love every day, and respond to His grace with a holy life. Amen!

v: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
b: This verse emphasizes the important role of the Holy Spirit in our sanctification. The Holy Spirit is not only our guide but also the source of power by which we are made holy. Through the Spirit's work, our lives are changed, our hearts are cleansed, and our conduct comes more into line with God's will.

Like a craftsman who skillfully polishes a rough stone into a beautiful statue, the Holy Spirit works in our lives without ceasing, transforming us from sinners into a holy people who please God. The process may be full of challenges, but the final result is what God delights in.

There was a sister named Li Jun who, not long after coming to faith, went through a spiritual low. She felt she could not overcome her inner weakness and even doubted whether she had truly received God's grace. But when she began to rely more on the Holy Spirit and to spend time in prayer and Scripture every day, she found that she was gradually freed from her old struggles and her heart grew more and more peaceful. In the end, Li Jun's life became steadier and more holy, and she became a spiritual example to many.

Li Jun's testimony tells us that the Holy Spirit is the key to our sanctification. As long as we are willing to open our hearts to Him, He will work in our lives and make us more and more like Christ.

Dear family, let us remember that through the work of the Holy Spirit we can become holy, and our lives can be acceptable to God. May we rely every day on the Spirit's power and let Him lead us along the path of sanctification.
ah: This verse reminds us that through the work of the Holy Spirit we are made holy and can be acceptable to God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Devotions and Prayer
Set aside a fixed time each day for fellowship with the Holy Spirit. Through devotions and prayer, let the Spirit guide you, so that your day is spent in holiness.
Sharing with Others
In daily life, especially among those who do not know the Lord, look for opportunities to share the gospel, so that more people may be made holy by the Holy Spirit and be acceptable to God.
Fellowship Life
Take part in church or small-group fellowship. Through sharing and mutual support, encourage one another's growth in the Spirit, and let this community life help each other rise higher in holiness.
Obey the Holy Spirit
When you face choices or challenges, be sensitive to the Spirit's prompting and choose to obey His leading, so that you can live a holy life and please God.
Generous Giving
Consider supporting the work of evangelism with concrete gifts of time, talent, or resources, so that more people have the chance to hear the gospel through your giving and be made holy.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us holy through the Holy Spirit and for accepting us. Please help us obey the Spirit's leading in daily life, share the gospel boldly, and glorify Your name with holy lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience the work of the Holy Spirit every day, and under His guidance live a holy life that pleases God. Amen!

v: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,
b: This verse reveals a profound spiritual principle: our sanctification is closely tied to belief in the truth and the work of the Holy Spirit. From the beginning God chose us, so that in Christ we would be made holy through belief in the truth. This is not because of our own effort or merit, but because of God's grace and His boundless love. We can be sanctified because we believed and accepted God's word, and under the Spirit's prompting we let God's truth take root in our hearts and change our thoughts and conduct.

It is like a tree. If its roots go deep into rich soil, it will surely grow strong and bear abundant fruit. In the same way, when our lives are rooted in the truth of God and we accept the Spirit's guidance, our spiritual life becomes firm and we gradually become a holy people who please God.

There was a sister named Wang Fang whose life bore witness to the power of this truth. Wang Fang came from a poor family and faced many challenges from childhood. When she was young, she was confused about life and did not know which road to take. Later she came into contact with the gospel and began to study the Bible seriously. As time went by, she found that God's word gave her direction and strength for life.

Especially when she learned the teaching about sanctification, she began to understand that her life's goal was not merely worldly success, but to live a holy life before God. Prompted by the Holy Spirit, Wang Fang decided to spend time each day in prayer and in meditating on Scripture, letting God's truth take root and sprout in her heart. As her understanding of the truth deepened, her life changed markedly. She no longer pursued material satisfaction, but focused on spiritual growth and an intimate relationship with God.
In the end, she became a spiritual leader in the church, and her life influenced many people.
Wang Fang's story tells us that when we root our lives in the truth of God and act under the Holy Spirit's prompting, we can live a holy life in this world and receive God's pleasure and blessing.

Dear family, let us remember that God has chosen us and made us holy through His truth and the prompting of the Holy Spirit. May we study and practice God's word more deeply every day, and let the Spirit guide us along the path of sanctification.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's choosing and the Spirit's prompting make us holy, so that we may be saved. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: A Thankful Heart
Each morning, make your first act thanking God for His choosing and the Spirit's work. This will help you live in gratitude and joy all day long.
Learning the Truth
Spend time every day studying the Bible, understand the truth deeply, and use it to guide your life, so that you are rooted in the truth and made holy.
The Spirit's Guidance
When you meet difficulty or must make a decision, ask for the Holy Spirit's guidance and trust His prompting, so that every decision reflects God's holiness.
Family Altar
Set up a family altar with your household, regularly sharing God's word and praying together, so that the whole family grows in holiness.
Encourage Others

Take the initiative to care for and encourage those around you, especially those struggling in their faith. By sharing your own experience and the Spirit's work, help them stand firm in faith as well.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing us from the beginning and for making us holy through the Holy Spirit. Please help us take root in the truth and, under the Spirit's guidance, live holy lives that glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be rooted in God's truth in your daily life and, under the Holy Spirit's guidance, keep growing and become a holy and blameless people who receive God's pleasure. Amen!

v: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
b: This verse is brief and powerful, yet it holds a profound spiritual truth. It tells us that the process of sanctification depends not only on our knowledge of God's word, but also on prayer, by which our lives are continually renewed. God's word is the foundation of our sanctification, and our prayer is an important tool by which we keep seeking God's help on our spiritual journey. As we keep receiving light from God's word and stay close to God through prayer, we will walk more and more steadily on the road of holiness.

It is like an athlete who must train every day and keep adjusting his condition in order to perform at his best. The process of sanctification is the same. We need to keep reading Scripture and praying, and seeking guidance in God's word, so that we can keep growing and become more and more like Christ.

There was a sister named Li Xia whose life bore witness to the deep connection between prayer and sanctification. Li Xia was a very devout Christian who kept up her morning devotions and prayer every day. But for a while she felt her spiritual life had fallen into a low and she could not sense God's presence. This left her confused and discouraged. So she began to seek God's will in prayer more earnestly. She not only poured out her confusion to God in prayer, but also began to learn how to listen for His voice. As she grew more focused in prayer, she began to sense the Holy Spirit working in her heart, and she gradually came out of the valley. Li Xia found that whenever she faced a challenge or difficulty, as long as she was willing to rely on God in prayer, God gave her strength and wisdom to keep walking on the road of sanctification.

Li Xia's story reminds us that prayer is an indispensable part of our spiritual life. Through prayer we can build a closer relationship with God and, with His help, keep growing to be more and more like Christ.

Dear family, let us remember that the process of sanctification depends not only on God's word but also on our continual prayer. May we draw near to God in prayer every day and seek His help, so that we keep moving forward on the road of sanctification.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's word and our prayer make us holy. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following 5 ways:
a: Daily Bible Reading
Set aside a fixed time each day to study the Bible, whether in the morning or before bed, and let God's word penetrate our hearts. This helps us become more holy in thought and conduct.
A Life of Prayer
Keep up a close conversation with God every day. Whether at home, at work, or anywhere else, we can pray at any time and place, so that we keep our hearts clean and stay connected to God.
Devotions and Meditation
Besides reading and praying, spend time meditating on God's word, so that it keeps working and renewing us in our hearts. This helps us live increasingly holy lives.
Share with Others
Share what we receive in devotions and prayer with others, whether at church, in a small group, or at home. Such sharing encourages us to pursue holiness together.
Keep a Devotional Journal
Start a devotional journal and write down each day's insights from reading and prayer. This not only deepens memory but also helps us look back on what God has done in our lives.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us Your word and for hearing our prayers. Please help us become holy through Your word and constant prayer, and become more like You each day. We pray in the victorious name of the Lord Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's abundant grace and guidance in your prayers every day, and keep growing in His word to become a holy and blameless people. Amen!

t: Without Holiness No One Will See the Lord
v: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
b: This verse stresses two vitally important spiritual goals: living in peace with others and pursuing holiness. The two are closely linked, because in God's eyes holiness is not merely personal character cultivation but also a reflection of our relationships with others. Peace with others is the outward expression of a holy life, while holiness is the loyalty and obedience of our hearts toward God.

Pursuing holiness is not easy. It requires us to examine our inner motives at all times, and to show reverence for God and love for others in our words and actions. We must remember that without holiness no one will see the Lord. This means that our lives must meet God's standard of holiness before we can be accepted in His presence.

There was a brother named Zhang Yong whose life showed both the difficulty and the blessing of pursuing holiness and peace with others. Zhang Yong had been a mid-level manager at his company, outstanding in his work, but because he focused so much on efficiency he neglected his colleagues' feelings, and relationships became strained. Later, in his devotions, he came to a deep understanding of this teaching and realized that a holy life is not just being outwardly blameless, but showing the love of Christ in the way we get along with others. He began to communicate with his colleagues, resolve past misunderstandings, and care more about others' needs at work. Gradually, not only did his relationships with his colleagues improve, but the whole working environment became more harmonious. Zhang Yong came to understand deeply that when he pursued holiness and lived in peace with others, God's grace appeared more abundantly in his life.

Zhang Yong's story reminds us that pursuing holiness and peace with others are not mutually exclusive, but inseparable parts of our spiritual life. As we strive to grow in both, God's presence will come to us more truly and lead us along His path.

Dear family, let us remember that without holiness no one will see the Lord. May we pursue holiness and peace with others in our daily lives, so that our lives are blameless before God and we may see His face in His glory.
ah: This verse reminds us to pursue peace with all people and to pursue holiness, because without holiness no one will see the Lord. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Mend Relationships

Take the initiative to mend broken relationships with others, especially conflicts with family, friends, or colleagues. Such reconciliation brings peace to your heart and promotes holiness in one another.
Avoid Quarrels
In daily life, especially at work or at home, learn to avoid unnecessary quarrels and choose to handle conflict with a peaceable heart. This will keep you calm and holy within.
Build Bridges of Peace
Take the initiative to be a peacemaker in your community, church, or family, promoting harmony and understanding. Such effort lets you be a witness to holiness in your life.
Keep Reflecting

Each day, reflect on whether you have kept peace and holiness in your dealings with others. This self-examination will let you keep adjusting your attitude and conduct to fit God's heart more closely.
Learn Forbearance
When others do wrong, choose forbearance and understanding, and lovingly bear with their weaknesses. In this way you can become more like Christ in holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us to pursue peace with all people and to pursue holiness. Please help us be peacemakers each day and become more like You in holiness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's abundant grace and guidance as you pursue holiness and peace with others, and may you grow strong in His love. Amen!

v: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
b: This verse points out that within marriage, a believing spouse has great influence on the spiritual condition of an unbelieving spouse and of the household. A holy life is not only a personal responsibility; through our words and actions it also affects those we love. When one spouse is willing to live a holy life in marriage, his or her faith and conduct become a light in the home and help the unbelieving spouse and the children come close to God's truth.

It is like a lamp set in the middle of a room. However dark the room is, as long as the lamp is burning, the whole room is lit. In the same way, when we hold to holiness in the family, our lives become a spiritual light in the home, leading those we love toward the light of God.

There was a sister named Zhang Jing whose life bore witness to the power of this verse. Early in their marriage, Zhang Jing's husband did not believe and had little interest in her faith. But she kept praying and reading Scripture every day, and created a home full of love and respect. Even in the face of her husband's indifference, she kept responding with gentleness and patience and practiced Christ's teaching in daily life. As time passed, her husband began to notice the joy and peace in her life and became curious about faith. In the end, because of her witness, Zhang Jing's husband decided to believe in the Lord, and their children also grew up in this family atmosphere to become devout Christians.

Zhang Jing's story tells us that when we hold to holiness in the family and treat others with the love of Christ, our lives will deeply influence those we love, so that they too can be lit by the light of God and walk the road of sanctification.

Dear family, let us remember that in marriage and family our holy lives have great influence. May we hold fast to our faith every day and guide our families with the love of Christ, so that our homes become a shining witness for God.
ah: This verse reminds us that a believing spouse has a spiritual influence on the unbelieving members of the family and can become a path to their sanctification. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Serve Your Family with Love
Whether or not your spouse believes, serve them with the love of Christ, so that God's love can touch their hearts through you.
Pray for Family Members

Pray every day for your spouse and family members, asking God to touch their hearts and bring the Holy Spirit's prompting into their lives. In this way you can lead your family toward holiness in the spirit.
Lead by Christ's Example
Be an example of Christ in the family. Whether handling stress, facing difficulty, or getting along with people, guide them with Christ's attitude, so that you can become a guide in their faith.
Create a Spiritual Atmosphere
Create a spiritual atmosphere at home, for example by playing worship music, hanging Scripture art, or taking part in church activities together, so that your family members can sense God's presence.
Share Your Testimony
At the right moment, share the testimony and experience of your faith with your spouse or family members, so they can see what God has done in your life and become interested in faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us families and the chance to be witnesses to holiness there. Please help us serve our spouses and family members with love and guide them toward holiness by Christ's example. May Your glory be revealed in our homes. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold to holiness in your family, and through your witness bring God's love and light to every member you love. Amen!

t: Holy in Spirit, Soul, and Body
v: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
b: This verse reminds us that whatever our circumstances in life, we are called to pursue holiness in spirit, soul, and body. An unmarried woman may have more time to devote to devotion and service, while a married woman may give more attention to her family and her husband's needs. Yet whatever our situation, God's heart is that we stay holy in every circumstance, in heart and in conduct, meeting God's standard.

It is like a sculptor at work. Whether he is shaping a rough block of stone or carving fine detail, every stroke must be precise and careful before the perfect form finally appears. In the same way, our lives are a work of art that God is carving. At every stage we need to focus on God's will so that we can remain holy in spirit, soul, and body and become a beautiful work in His hands.

There was a sister named Li Peijun whose life bore witness to this truth. In her youth, Peijun had a strong desire to serve, and whether at church or in the community she poured a great deal of time and energy into gospel work. Later she married, and family life became the center of her life. Although her time became limited, she did not give up the pursuit of holiness in spirit, soul, and body. Every morning she still kept up her devotions and prayer, and she lived out Christ's pattern in her home, managing her family with love and wisdom. In raising her children and caring for her husband, she wove God's truth into everyday life and made her family her main field of service. Li Peijun's perseverance and faith not only brought her own spiritual growth but also influenced her husband and children, so that they too walked the path of faith.
Peijun's story tells us that whatever stage of life we are in, as long as our hearts are set on God's will, we can stay holy in spirit, soul, and body and bear witness to Christ in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that whatever our circumstances, we are called to be wholly holy in spirit, soul, and body. May we, in every day of our lives and whatever challenges we face, stay focused on God's will, so that our lives are without spot or blemish before Him.
ah: This verse reminds us that whether or not we are married, we should set apart our bodies and spirits as holy and focus on pleasing God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Focused Devotions
Whether or not you are married, set aside time every day for devotions, Bible reading, and prayer, so that your spirit stays pure and holy.
Manage Your Time
Plan your time carefully and avoid wasting it on entertainment or worldly affairs. Give more of your time to God's work, so that you can serve God better and glorify Him.
Care for Your Body
Keep healthy habits, eat a balanced diet, and exercise regularly, so that you can serve God in better condition and let your body be a holy temple.
Devotions as a Couple
If you are married, have devotions together with your spouse, support one another, and pursue holiness together in marriage, so that your marriage is firmer and blessed by God.
A Pure Heart
Keep your thoughts and feelings pure, and avoid unhealthy thoughts or emotional bondage, so that you can focus more on God and let your spirit be holy before Him.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to set apart our bodies and spirits as holy. Whatever our circumstances, please help us focus on pleasing You and keep our hearts and bodies holy, that our lives may glorify You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold to holiness in spirit, soul, and body every day, and be a beautiful witness for God. Amen!

v: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
b: This verse reminds us that our lives and bodies belong to God, and we should offer ourselves wholly as a living sacrifice and live for Him. The idea of a living sacrifice means that our life is offered to God continually every day, not only in moments of worship at church but in every detail of daily life. Our thoughts, words, and actions should all reflect our reverence and obedience toward God. Such a life is what pleases Him.

It is like a professional athlete. Whether in competition or in daily training, the goal is the same: to reach peak condition and be ready to win the game. In the same way, the lives of us Christians should be lived for the Lord every day, prepared for Him, continually offering ourselves as a living sacrifice that pleases God.

There was a brother named Liu Qiang whose life is a vivid picture of this verse. Liu Qiang was a young Christian who, from his university years, resolved to give his whole life to God. He did not worship God only at Sunday gatherings, but worked to practice his faith in life every day. In his studies he stayed honest and diligent, with no shortcuts and no laziness; in dealing with others he always showed Christ's love and patience. After graduating he chose a job in social service, bringing love to those who needed help. Liu Qiang's life has not only blessed those around him but has also caused him to grow continually in his spiritual life and draw ever closer to God.

Liu Qiang's story tells us that offering ourselves as a living sacrifice is not merely a slogan but a way of life, our daily worship and offering to God. When we are willing to live wholly for the Lord, His grace will be greatly revealed in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that our lives are given by God, and offering them as a living sacrifice is our best response to Him. May we live out a holy life in every detail of our days and become a living sacrifice that pleases God.
ah: This verse reminds us that to present our bodies to God as a living sacrifice is holy and pleasing to Him. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Daily Offering
Each morning after you get up, offer your day to God and dedicate all your actions and thoughts to Him, so that you stay in God's will at all times.
Use Your Body Well
Use your body to serve God, whether in church ministry or in helping people in need, so that your body becomes an instrument God can use.
A Healthy Life
Keep a healthy lifestyle and stay away from any habit that harms your body, so that you can serve God in the best condition and glorify Him.
Holy Thoughts
Keep your thoughts holy and avoid any thought that does not fit God's heart, so that your spirit and body together may be a sacrifice God delights in.
Active Service
Take an active part in service at church or in the community and invest your time and energy in God's work, so that you offer every part of your life to God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for letting us present our bodies as a holy living sacrifice. Please help us keep our hearts and bodies holy every day and glorify You with our actions and thoughts. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live a holy life for the Lord every day, be a witness to His glory, and keep growing in His grace. Amen!

v: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
b: This verse encourages us to stand firm on the path of faith, so that our hearts may be established and we may become holy and blameless. This is the kind of life every Christian should pursue, because it is not only our glory before God but also a beautiful witness before the world. When we strive to live a holy and blameless life, our lives reflect the radiance of Christ and draw more people to know Him.

It is like an architect putting up a tall building. He must make sure every brick and every beam is placed correctly, or the whole building will risk collapse. Our life of faith is the same: every act and every decision should meet God's standard, so that we can stand before Him.

There was a brother named Chen Enliang who faced many moral and integrity challenges in the workplace. Once his company asked him to take part in an unethical business operation, and if he agreed, the company would promote him and raise his pay. Facing the temptation, Enliang held to the principles of his faith, refused the operation, and made his position clear to his superiors. This decision briefly cost him the chance of promotion, but the peace in his heart and his loyalty to God made him firmer in his faith. A few years later, the company discovered the problems with that operation and began to value employees of integrity, and in the end Enliang was promoted to a higher position because of his honesty and faith.

Enliang's experience tells us that whatever challenges we face, as long as we are willing to hold to holiness and be blameless, we will receive God's approval and become His witnesses before the world.

Dear family, let us remember that our lives are to be established before God and become a witness of holiness and blamelessness. May we, in every day of our lives, bear witness to Christ's love and truth with firm faith and holy conduct.
ah: This verse reminds us to keep our hearts established before God, holy and blameless, to welcome the Lord's return. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Strengthen Your Faith Daily
Strengthen your faith each day with prayer and Bible reading, so that you can stand firm when you face difficulty.
Maintain Integrity
In life, whether at work or at home, be upright and honest, so that you are blameless before God and people.
Cleanse Your Heart
Regularly reflect spiritually and examine yourself for anything that needs repentance, so that you keep your heart holy and have no fear of God's judgment.
Let Hope Be Your Motivation
Remind yourself often of the Lord Jesus' return and let this hope be the motivation of your life, so that you can live each day a life that pleases God.
Fellowship with the Saints
Take an active part in church life and fellowship with other believers, growing together, so that you are more firmly established spiritually and support one another on the path of holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us holy and blameless in Jesus Christ. Please help us strengthen our faith, stay upright, cleanse our hearts, and welcome the Lord's return with hope as our motivation. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. As you hold to holiness, may you receive God's grace and strength, be blameless before Him, and be a witness to His glory. Amen!

v: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
b: This verse reminds us that as Christians we should regard and keep our bodies with holiness and honor. God gave us our bodies as His vessels on earth, and we should treasure and make good use of this vessel, making it an instrument that glorifies God rather than one that indulges the desires of the flesh. Our bodies are temples of the Holy Spirit, so we should treat them with reverence and care. Only then can we live a life that fits God's heart.

It is like a skilled instrument maker who carefully chooses every piece of wood and polishes and assembles it with great care, making sure each instrument can produce a pure sound. In the same way, we should guard our bodies carefully and let them be instruments God uses, sounding beautiful spiritual notes, rather than being defiled by worldly desires.

There was a sister named Li Yuxin whose life bore witness to the practice of this verse. In her youth, Yuxin went through a serious health problem, which led her to reflect on her way of life. She realized that in the past she had neglected the care of her body and had not treated it with holiness. So she resolved to change her lifestyle, paying closer attention not only to diet and exercise but also to seeking God's word in her devotions. As time passed, both her body and her spirit were restored, and she became a promoter of healthy living in the church, influencing many brothers and sisters to join her in this way of life.

Yuxin's story tells us that keeping the body in holiness is not only responsibility toward ourselves but also a form of worship toward God. When we keep our bodies with a holy attitude, God also gives us His grace and makes our lives richer.

Dear family, let us remember that our bodies are precious gifts from God, and we should treat them with holiness and honor and glorify God's name in life. May we all practice the teaching of this verse every day and live a holy life.
ah: This verse reminds us to guard our bodies with holiness and honor, because our bodies are the temple God has given us. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Healthy Eating
Choose a healthy, balanced diet and stay away from poor eating habits, so that you treat your body with honor and holiness.
Regular Exercise
Exercise appropriately and regularly to keep your body healthy, so that your body can better carry the mission God has given you.
Clean Thoughts
Avoid contact with anything impure, such as unhealthy media or evil thoughts, so that you keep your thoughts and heart holy, which in turn shapes your bodily conduct.
Respect Others
In your interactions with others, treat their bodies with respect and love, so that you embody the principle of holiness in your relationships.
Ask for God's Protection
Each day ask God to protect your body and heart, so that you can live a witness of holiness and honor and let God's glory be revealed in you.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us to guard our bodies with holiness and honor. Please help us, through healthy habits and clean thoughts in daily life, to respect the bodies You have given us and so glorify You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you keep your body in holiness and honor every day, and experience God's grace and blessing in the process. Amen!

v: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
b: This verse reminds us that faith, love, and holy self-discipline are important virtues in the life of every Christian. These virtues are not only inner qualities but should be shown in every area of our daily lives, especially when we face challenges and difficulties. Holy self-discipline means that before temptation and testing we keep self-control, are not stained by sin, and do not let our conduct contradict God's holiness.

It is like a ship sailing on the sea. However the waves surge, the captain must stay steady and hold the helm firmly to keep the ship from straying off course. In the same way, in life we must always keep our spiritual steadiness, holding to faith and holiness and not being swayed by worldly temptation.

There was a sister named Li Mei who went through many hard trials in her marriage. Her husband, under the pressure of work, gradually grew cold and even began to feel distant from the family. Facing this, Li Mei did not give up her faith. She often prayed for her husband and held their marriage together with love and faith. Although she sometimes felt discouraged and powerless, she always kept holy self-discipline and was not crushed by any outside pressure. In the end her husband was moved by her perseverance and love, returned to God, and their marriage was restored and became stronger.

Li Mei's story tells us that holy self-discipline is a power, an important safeguard that lets us stay spiritually steady even in hardship. When we choose to walk in faith and love and meet life's challenges with a holy attitude, God's grace will surely follow.

Dear family, let us remember that holy self-discipline is an important spiritual practice in our lives. Whatever difficulties and temptations we face, as long as we continue in faith and love and hold to holiness, God's salvation and blessing will surely come to us.
ah: This verse reminds us that faith, love, and holy self-discipline are indispensable elements in a Christian's life, especially important when we face life's challenges. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Form a Faith Group
Organize or join a faith group to share the challenges and testimonies of the life of faith regularly and support one another, so that you can grow in faith and stay firm.
One Good Deed a Day
Plan one act of kindness out of love each day, whether for family, friends, or strangers, so that you live out love and grow in it.
A Fixed Devotional Time
Set a fixed time every day for devotions, Bible reading, prayer, and meditation on God's word, so that you keep your spiritual life holy and self-disciplined and stay away from temptation.
Set Life Standards
Set standards for yourself according to biblical principles and stay holy in word and deed, so that you can hold firm against the world's enticements.
A Family Prayer Circle
Pray together with your family every day, especially asking God's protection and blessing for mothers, so that the whole family takes part in a life of faith and holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing us the importance of faith, love, and holy self-discipline. Please help us put these truths into practice every day, keep our faith firm, live out love, and stay self-disciplined in holiness, so that our whole lives glorify You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold to holiness in faith and love, and in any circumstance overcome every temptation and difficulty with spiritual strength. Amen!

v: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
b: This verse stresses the virtues a Christian life should have: hospitality, goodness, sobriety, justice, and holy self-control. These virtues form the foundation of our spiritual life and guide how we conduct ourselves in this world. Holy self-control is a power of self-mastery and self-management that keeps us from being drawn along by worldly trends and lets us live according to God's will.

It is like a skilled navigator who, sailing on the sea, constantly watches the wind and currents and adjusts the ship's course to make sure the vessel is heading toward its goal. In the same way, our lives are ships under sail and need holy self-control at the helm, so that we do not stray from God's will and can safely reach the beautiful future God has prepared.

There was a brother named Li Wenjie who was a successful manager in the workplace, yet he never pursued personal fame or gain; he treated every employee on the principles of fairness and kindness. He often welcomed those who were having trouble at work and gave them help and support. His way of managing filled the whole team with positive energy and unity. Yet Li Wenjie was not free from temptation. His company once had a chance to profit quickly by unethical means, but Li Wenjie held to the principle of holy self-control and chose the upright road. In the end his company not only built a good reputation in the industry but also attracted more outstanding people to join.

Li Wenjie's experience tells us that holy self-control is not a momentary decision but a long-term spiritual discipline. This discipline lets us, whatever challenges we face, hold to the principles of our faith and not stray from God's will.

Dear family, let us remember that holy self-control is the secret to staying pure and upright in this complicated world. May we all, with God's help, hold to such virtues, so that our lives become a witness to His glory.
ah: This verse reminds us that holy self-control is not only personal cultivation but is also shown in our interactions with others. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Welcome New Friends
At church or in the community, take the initiative to welcome newcomers and let them feel Christ's love, so that you live out the spirit of loving goodness and hospitality.
Join Public Service
Take an active part in community service, whether volunteering or charitable giving, so that you express goodwill and fairness toward others in action.
Cultivate Dignified Conduct
In your words and behavior, deliberately cultivate a dignified and humble attitude and avoid being careless or frivolous, so that you show the character a Christian should have.
Keep Your Heart Pure
Keep your thoughts and feelings pure and stay away from the temptations that would draw us from holy self-control, so that your inner life and outward conduct together reflect God's holiness.
Daily Reflection
Reflect each day on whether your conduct meets God's standard and whether anything needs repentance, so that you keep practicing holy self-control in life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for letting us learn how to practice holy self-control in our dealings with others. Please help us glorify Your name in daily life by welcoming strangers, delighting in doing good, treating others fairly, and conducting ourselves with dignity, and keep our hearts always pure. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you keep holy self-control every day and show God's grace and power in every challenge. Amen!

v: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
b: This verse reminds us to keep our hearts calm and holy in prayer, free from anger and argument, giving our whole hearts to God. Prayer is sacred communication and an important way to build our relationship with God. When we pray, no matter how high we lift our hands, if our hearts hold resentment and argument, our prayer cannot truly be accepted by God. So keeping the heart pure and peaceful is the key to experiencing God's presence in prayer.

It is like a musician. If he is restless and uneasy inside as he plays, however skilled his technique, the music he produces will hardly move anyone. In the same way, in prayer, only when our hearts are calm and undisturbed and full of reverence and love for God can our prayers be full of power.

There was a brother named Zhang Wei who used to have a hot temper and often quarreled with his family and colleagues. Later, at a church retreat, he saw his problem clearly and resolved to change. He began spending time in prayer every morning, asking God to help him overcome the habits of anger and argument. As time went by, Zhang Wei's temperament grew gentler and gentler, and his family and colleagues noticed the change. His prayer life not only changed him but also made him a peacemaker at home and at work, bringing harmony and love.

Zhang Wei's story tells us that when we are willing to lay down the anger and argument in our hearts and lift up holy hands to God in prayer, God will surely give us strength and peace, and make our lives a channel of His blessing.

Dear family, let us remember that prayer is not merely lifting up our hands but lifting up a holy and peaceful heart before God. May every prayer of ours be accepted by God and find strength in His love.
ah: This verse reminds us that in every circumstance we should keep a peaceful heart and lift up holy hands to pray everywhere. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Daily Quiet Meditation
