Spend a few minutes each day in quiet meditation, laying down the restlessness and argument in your heart and letting God's peace fill you, so that you can better face life's challenges.
Settle Disputes with Prayer
When there is an argument at home or at work, stop arguing first and seek God's guidance in prayer, so that you avoid conflict and keep your heart at peace.
A Prayer Alliance
Form a prayer alliance with friends or family and pray for one another anytime and anywhere, so that you can lift up holy hands in every area of life and pray everywhere.
Defuse Anger
Learn to manage your emotions. Especially when angry, first take a deep breath and pray, so that you stay holy in your emotions and do not let anger control you.
Create a Prayer Corner
Set up a quiet prayer corner at home or at work where you can pray briefly and reflect at any time, so that you keep your spiritual life holy amid a busy life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us how to keep a peaceful heart in life. Please help us, when we meet challenges and arguments, to pray instead of quarrel, to lift up holy hands and pray everywhere, and to fill our lives with Your peace and grace. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often experience God's presence in prayer and pour out your heart to Him with a holy and peaceful spirit. Amen!

v: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.
b: This verse teaches us that to become a vessel God greatly uses, we need not only God's choosing but also our own cleansing and effort. Turning away from the ignoble means giving up the sin and unrighteousness that defile our souls and pursuing spiritual purity and holiness. Only then can we become precious vessels in God's hands, accomplishing His good purposes for Him.

It is like a plain, unremarkable stone that, after being polished by a sculptor, finally becomes a precious work of art. Its roughness and flaws are removed one by one, and its inner beauty finally appears. In the same way, our lives are continually polished in God's hands. As long as we are willing to cleanse ourselves and leave the ignoble, we can be used by God and become vessels of His glory.

There was a brother named Zhou Qiang who was once addicted to worldly pleasures, lived recklessly, and kept bad company. But at one gathering he heard a pastor's sermon, was deeply moved, and resolved to change. He began to stay away from the friends and places that tempted him to sin, and read Scripture and prayed every day, seeking spiritual growth. As time passed, Zhou Qiang's life changed greatly. He became a zealous servant in the church, often praying for and helping the brothers and sisters. His life bore witness to God's grace and became a spiritual example to many.

Zhou Qiang's story reminds us that cleansing ourselves and leaving the ignoble is a spiritual process every Christian must go through. When we are willing to make such a choice, God will surely lift us up, give us new missions and responsibilities, and make us His precious vessels.

Dear family, let us remember that self-cleansing is not easy, but it is the necessary road to holiness and to becoming a vessel God uses greatly. May we all keep pursuing spiritual growth on this road and become workers fit for God's use.
ah: This verse reminds us to cleanse ourselves and stay away from the ignoble, so that we can become vessels suitable for the Master's use. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Build a Habit of Self-Reflection
Spend time each day in self-reflection, checking whether you have done anything ignoble, such as lying or malicious criticism, and use that time to ask God to cleanse your heart.
Clear Out the Clutter of the Heart
Just as you tidy a room, regularly clear out negative emotions and unclean thoughts from your heart, so that you become a holy vessel before God.
Take Part in Good Deeds
Take the initiative to join service activities at church or in the community and show God's love in practical action, so that you become a precious vessel God uses.
Choose Wholesome Entertainment
Stay away from entertainment harmful to your spirit, such as violence or pornography, and choose positive forms of entertainment, so that your heart stays pure.
Spiritual Companionship
Build a spiritual companionship with a spiritually mature friend, encouraging and holding each other accountable to pursue holiness in life and be fit for the Lord's use.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding us to cleanse ourselves and leave the ignoble. May we keep our hearts clean at all times and be precious vessels fit for Your hand, prepared for every good work, to glorify Your holy name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, led by God each day, cleanse yourself and leave the ignoble, becoming a vessel He delights in and doing His good works. Amen!

v: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
b: This verse is a solemn reminder that when we face the final judgment, people will be defined and judged by the choices they made over a lifetime. Holiness is an ongoing state, not a one-time act. Staying holy is the lifelong pursuit of a Christian, not only for present blessing but so that we may stand before God.

It is like an athlete who trains not only before the game but also keeps a healthy diet and a regular routine in daily life, so that he can perform at his best on game day. In the same way, a Christian's holiness requires spiritual discipline built up day after day, and we must always stay alert so as not to be defiled by the world.

There was a sister named Li Enping who resolved to follow Jesus from her youth and served zealously in church. But when she entered the workplace, because of a busy schedule and the pressures of life, she gradually drifted from God and even began to take part in some activities contrary to the teaching of the Bible. Yet God's love did not give up on her. One day she attended a spiritual retreat, and God's word touched her heart again and showed her how far her spiritual life had strayed. She repented on the spot and resolved anew to live a holy life. Back at work, she kept reading Scripture and praying every day and stayed away from everything that would draw her from God. In the end she became light and salt in the workplace and influenced many colleagues.

Enping's story tells us that staying holy is not easy, especially in a world full of temptation and challenge. But when we are willing to turn back and hold to holiness, God gives us strength to walk the path of righteousness.
Dear family, let us remember that holiness is not a choice made once but a lifelong pursuit. May we remain holy in God's grace every day and be a witness to His glory.
ah: This verse reminds us that in these last days we should persist in pursuing holiness and not be influenced by the world. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through concrete actions, in the following ways:
a: Uninterrupted Daily Devotions
However busy life is, keep reading Scripture and praying every day, so that we keep growing in our spiritual lives and keep a holy heart.
Stay Away from Unrighteous Conduct
At work and in life, actively stay away from any behavior that might lead us into unrighteousness, and choose to pursue righteousness in all things.
Build a Barrier of Faith
When worldly temptation comes, learn to refuse it, and make spiritual principles the barrier of faith in your life, so that we can hold to holiness through every kind of temptation.
Influence Others Positively
In your family, workplace, or social settings, influence others by example and by word, leading them to pursue righteousness and holiness together.
Take Communion Regularly
Take part in Communion regularly, to remind yourself of the sacrifice the Lord Jesus made for us and to resolve anew to live a holy life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us to keep pursuing holiness in these last days. Please help us stay holy through every temptation and challenge, unaffected by the world, and become a good influence on others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold to holiness in daily life and, whatever challenges come, follow the Lord faithfully until you see His face. Amen!

v: Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his commandments,
b: This verse stresses God's faithfulness and unchanging love, reminding us that God keeps covenant and shows lovingkindness. However we change, stumble, or break faith, God's faithfulness never changes. He is not only the God who created us but also the God who is long-suffering and keeps His promises. His faithfulness is something we can rely on, and His lovingkindness lasts to a thousand generations and never ends.

It is like a farmer who sows and tills year after year. Whatever the weather, he stays by his fields, believing that in due time the land will bear abundant fruit. In the same way, God's love and faithfulness toward us are like that farmer's trust in the land. He always watches over us, and however fierce the storms of our lives, His promises remain firm and unchanged.

There was a brother named Li Qiang who lost his job in a severe economic crisis, and his family fell into hardship. He was lost and anxious, not knowing how to face the challenge ahead. Yet every day he prayed without ceasing, entrusting this hardship to God and believing that God's faithfulness would carry him through. Sure enough, God wonderfully arranged a new job opportunity, which not only solved his present difficulty but also let him see that God's grace was beyond all he could imagine. Li Qiang's testimony shows us that God's faithfulness never lets us down. He opens a way out in our difficulty so that we can go on.

Dear family, let us remember that our God is the faithful God, who keeps covenant and shows lovingkindness to a thousand generations. We can trust Him fully, because His promises will never change. Whatever difficulty or challenge we are going through, God will surely lead us through by His faithfulness and give us abundant grace.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness is endlessly long and that He shows lovingkindness to a thousand generations. This inspires us to reflect our response to His faithfulness in life. Here are some concrete and creative ways to put it into practice:
a: "Faithfulness Challenge" action plan: Set a one-month "Faithfulness Challenge" in which each day you choose one area to keep your word faithfully, such as finishing your work on time, showing up as promised, or continuing to express support to others. This challenge not only reminds us of God's faithfulness but also trains us to learn to imitate Him in life.
Regular Family Faith-Sharing Time

Choose one day each month to share with your family stories of God's faithfulness felt during that time, and encourage everyone to testify with specific events how God kept His covenant and showed grace. This helps the whole family grow together in faith.
Faithfulness Notebook

Prepare a "Faithfulness Notebook" to record the faithfulness God shows in your life. Whenever you experience God's grace, big or small, write it down and review it regularly. This strengthens your confidence in God and can also be material for testimony.
Faithfulness Care Group

Each week, take the initiative to contact three friends or family members, ask how they are, offer practical help, or pray for their needs. This reflects your faithful commitment to others and helps more people feel God's love.
Keeping-Time Plan

Set up a "promise-keeping clock" plan to train yourself to be punctual and work more efficiently. This plan helps you imitate God's faithfulness, practicing time management and keeping commitments to others in small things, so that you become a reliable person.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being the faithful and unchanging God who always keeps covenant and shows lovingkindness to those who love You. Please help us learn to be faithful to You in every small thing in life and to treat the people around us with love and faithfulness. May our lives be a reflection of Your faithfulness, bringing blessing and testimony. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's faithful leading every day, find strength and hope in His lovingkindness, and enjoy His unchanging grace. Amen!

v: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
b: This verse reminds us that God is faithful. He has not only called us to belong to Him but wants us to share with His Son, Jesus Christ, the eternal inheritance. God's faithfulness is shown not only in His past promises but also in His leading of our lives every day. His call to us is to make us members of His kingdom, sharing with Christ in immeasurable glory.

It is like a conductor who carefully chooses each musician and makes sure each plays their own part, so that together they play one perfect piece. God's faithfulness is the same. He calls us into His kingdom and places us in His perfect plan, so that in union with Christ we may sound together a spiritual harmony.

There was a sister named Zhang Min who had been through a low point in life. During that time she felt she had lost her direction, and her heart was full of confusion and helplessness. But in prayer she heard God's call and understood that her life had a higher purpose: to share with Christ and to be a witness of God's kingdom with Him. Zhang Min began to reorder her life, her spiritual life revived, and she became a servant in the church leading prayer and worship. Her life bore witness to God's faithfulness and grace, helped her find her direction again, and let her experience God's abundant grace in service.
Zhang Min's testimony tells us that God is faithful. He does not let our lives lose direction, but through His calling leads us into the abundant life He has prepared for us.

Dear family, let us remember that God is faithful and has called us to share His kingdom with Christ. May we hear His call every day, find strength and hope in His faithfulness, and live out the abundant life that belongs to God.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God is faithful and calls us to share the inheritance with Jesus Christ. Here are a few concrete ways to put it into practice:
a: Daily Cooperation Plan

In daily work or life, when you work with others, set goals and be sure to keep your word, whether in a workplace project or a family responsibility. Build trust with others, which also reflects our faithfulness to Christ.

Set up a "Faithful Companion" arrangement: find a brother or sister you trust, and become "faithful companions" to each other. Once a week share your struggles and testimonies in the life of faith, and encourage each other to stay faithful to God's call.
Daily Grace List

Each day, record the grace of God you have experienced, especially the moments when God showed His faithfulness. This will encourage you and help you remember your relationship with Christ at all times.
Faithful Giving Day
Set one day each month as a "Faithful Giving Day," and give your time, resources, or talents, whether at church or at home, doing all you can to help others.

A commemoration "Sharing with Jesus": choose a special day each year and invite brothers and sisters to share the grace of sharing the inheritance with Christ. Through worship, sharing testimonies, or evangelism, strengthen one another's faith in Christ.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, You are the true and living God, and You have called us to share the inheritance with Jesus Christ. Please help us stay faithful to Your call in life, and let each of our actions reflect Your faithfulness. May we build loyal and reliable relationships with others at work, at home, and in church, to glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel God's faithfulness every day and, under His leading, walk into a destiny of abundance and glory. Amen!

v: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
b: This verse brings us great comfort and hope. It reminds us that God's faithfulness and righteousness guarantee that if we confess our sins, He will forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness. This lets us understand that whatever mistakes we have made in the past, as long as we are willing to come before God and admit our wrongdoing, He will forgive us with His faithfulness and lovingkindness.

It is like a doctor who is always glad to help patients recover. However serious the illness, as long as the patient is willing to admit the condition and accept treatment, the doctor will do everything to heal them. In the same way, God's faithfulness and righteousness are the physician of our souls. He is willing to pardon our faults and give complete healing.

There was a sister named He Li who had been deeply caught in guilt over her past and felt she did not deserve God's love and forgiveness. But at a devotional gathering she heard this verse and understood that God is faithful and would forgive her sin and cleanse her past. He Li bravely confessed her sin to God, and she deeply felt God's pardon and acceptance. From then on she began her spiritual journey anew, her life was full of joy and peace, and she became a spiritual counselor helping others, passing on God's forgiveness and love to more people in need.

He Li's experience tells us that God's faithfulness and righteousness are boundless grace. As long as we are willing to come before Him and admit our wrongdoing, He will forgive us and give us new life.

Dear family, let us remember that our God is faithful, and His forgiveness and love are always open, waiting for our repentance and return. May we walk every day in this light of faithfulness and receive God's unconditional love and forgiveness.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness and righteousness give us forgiveness and cleansing when we confess our sins. Here are some concrete and creative ways to put it into practice:
a: Spiritual Cleansing Day

Choose one day each month as your "Spiritual Cleansing Day." Spend time quietly before God, examine your heart and conduct, and sincerely confess your sins to Him, so that the day becomes a day of renewed strength.
Confession Devotional Journal
Start a "Confession Devotional Journal." Each day review whether you have any faults, and write down your experience of confessing to God, recording how God leads you to forgiveness and renewal.

A "Forgiveness Conversation" plan: find a trusted spiritual partner and hold regular "forgiveness conversations," honestly sharing the struggles and sins in your lives and praying for each other. This will help you build habits of confession, forgiveness, and renewal.
Home Cleansing Day

As a symbol, choose a day to tidy your home and clear out things you do not need, as a picture of cleansing the heart, reminding yourself that just like a home, the heart needs regular clearing of sin and filth.

A "Blessing of Forgiveness" action: learn to extend God's forgiveness into your relationships by taking the initiative to forgive those who have wronged you and looking for opportunities to be reconciled. This lets you witness God's forgiveness and faithfulness in real life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your faithful and righteous character. When we confess our sins, You forgive us and cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Please help us form the habit of honest confession before You, so that our lives are cleansed through Your forgiveness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's faithful forgiveness and new birth with each repentance, and find complete freedom and joy in His love. Amen!

v: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
b: This verse brings us great comfort. It reminds us that whatever temptation or challenge we face, God's faithfulness guarantees that He will not let us carry a burden beyond our ability. Temptation cannot be avoided, but God's faithfulness provides us a way out, so that we can endure it and in the end overcome.

It is like a coach training an athlete. Although he designs hard training, he never gives the athlete a load beyond his ability. The coach helps them build up their strength step by step, so that they grow through the challenge. In the same way, God will not let us face a temptation we cannot bear. At our hardest moment He always prepares a way out for us and helps us overcome the challenge by His strength.

There was a brother named Chen Qiang who once met a serious crisis in his career. His company faced collapse, and his family life took a heavy blow. He often felt helpless and in despair, doubting whether he could bear such pressure. But in prayer he remembered this verse and understood that God would not let him carry a burden beyond his ability. As time passed, God truly opened a way out for him. He found a new opportunity and started his business again, relying more on God's strength in the process and experiencing God's faithfulness.
Chen Qiang's experience tells us that however great the temptation or difficulty we are facing, God's faithfulness will help us find a way out and give us strength to endure the temptation.

Dear family, let us remember that our God is faithful. He will not let us be tempted beyond what we can bear, and He will surely open a way out for us. May we trust God every day and, whatever challenge we face, overcome by His faithfulness.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God faithfully provides a way out when we face temptation and helps us endure the test. Here are some concrete and creative ways to put it into practice:
a: Way-Out Marker Plan

In the areas of your life where you easily face temptation, set a "way-out marker" for yourself. For example, if you easily lose your temper under work stress, set a reminder telling yourself to calm down or take a short break. This will help you keep self-control.
Temptation Journal

Keep a "temptation journal" recording the temptations you face each day and writing down how God gave you a way out in them. This not only helps you notice your own weaknesses but also bears witness to God's faithfulness.
Spiritual First-Aid Kit

Prepare a "spiritual first-aid kit" containing Scripture cards, spiritual books, or worship music. When you feel especially discouraged or face temptation, open these tools and look for spiritual support and reminders.
Temptation Preparation Group
Form a group with brothers and sisters from church to discuss regularly the temptations you meet in life, pray for one another, and look for concrete strategies to overcome these challenges.
Endurance Challenge Day
Each week choose one day as an "Endurance Challenge Day," deliberately facing a situation you find difficult, and record how God helped you find a way out and endure.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being unchangingly faithful when we face temptation and always preparing a way out for us. Please give us strength and wisdom to endure to the end, to find spiritual support and help, to stay away from temptation, and to live the life You delight in. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, when you face temptation and challenge, rely on God's faithfulness, find a way out, and overcome in His grace. Amen!

v: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
b: This verse reminds us that when we act according to God's will, even if we suffer, we can safely entrust our souls to the faithful Creator. God not only created us; He also guards us faithfully. Even when we face hardship in this world, God's faithfulness remains our assurance, and He will not let us be crushed in suffering.

It is like a sculptor creating a work. Although the process requires repeated carving, he always trusts that his work will in the end be perfect. In the same way, God is our Creator. He keeps shaping us in faithfulness, He knows our limits, and He faithfully guards us until we become what He designed.

There was a sister named Zhang Hui who went through much suffering on her journey of faith, including the death of family members and health problems, but she never gave up her trust in God. Zhang Hui understood that these sufferings were not evidence that God had abandoned her, but moments when she needed to entrust herself wholly to God. In her suffering she kept doing good and kept serving God, and she witnessed God's faithful protection. In the end, Zhang Hui became not only firmer in her spiritual life but also an encouragement and example to many brothers and sisters.
Zhang Hui's story reminds us that whatever suffering we go through, when we entrust ourselves to the faithful God, He will guard us in suffering and let our souls find rest in Him.
Dear family, let us remember that God is our faithful Creator. He guards us in faithfulness, and whatever challenge or suffering we go through, He will lead us through and let our souls enjoy rest.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that even in suffering we should trust God, because He is the faithful Creator, and we should persist in doing good. Here are some concrete and creative ways to put it into practice:
a: Thanksgiving Day in Suffering

v: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.
b: This verse reminds us that God is faithful. He not only gives us strength but also protects us from the attacks of the evil one. He will strengthen us in danger and build an invisible wall of protection around us, so that we do not fall into the devil's snare.

It is like a strong fortress. When a storm comes, the people inside can rely entirely on its solid walls to protect themselves. In the same way, God's faithfulness is like that fortress. When we meet spiritual attack and temptation, His faithfulness is our protection, letting us come safely through the storm.

There was a brother named Lin Qiang who had gone through many spiritual struggles in his faith, and especially when facing temptation he felt very helpless. But in prayer he experienced God's faithfulness. God gave him strength to resist the attacks of the evil one, and he gradually regained inner peace. Lin Qiang later not only overcame temptation but also became a leader in the church helping other brothers and sisters resist spiritual attack.
Lin Qiang's story tells us that God is faithful. When we rely on His strength, He builds a spiritual barrier for us, protects us from the traps of the evil one, and strengthens our faith.
Dear family, let us remember that the Lord is faithful. He will surely protect us from the evil one and give us strength to overcome in spiritual warfare.

t: The One Who Promised Is Faithful
v: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
b: This verse reminds us that however our circumstances change, God's promises never change. The hope He gives us is not temporary but built on His eternal, unchanging faithfulness. In this promise we can find comfort and strength. Whether we face hardship or challenge in life, God's faithfulness guarantees that He will fulfill every word He has promised us.

It is like sailing on a stormy sea, where the needle of the compass always points steadily north. However the waves surge, the needle does not stray. In the same way, God's faithfulness is like that steady needle, leading us toward the land of peace He has promised.

There was a brother named Li Junwei who once faced a long period of unemployment. In those hard days Junwei often felt uncertain about the future and even questioned his direction. But every morning he kept reading Scripture and praying, meditating on God's promises and reminding himself that God is faithful and His promises never fail. In the end, after several months of waiting, Junwei not only found a job but received more blessing than he had asked for, a position that fit his profession even better. This let him deeply understand that God's faithfulness and promises are beyond what we can imagine.

Junwei's story tells us that when we choose to hold to our faith, even in the storms of life, we will see God's promises fulfilled one by one. God's faithfulness is an assurance we can rely on every day, letting us find peace and joy in difficulty.

Dear family, let us remember that God is faithful, and what He has promised He will surely accomplish. Whatever our situation now, because of God's faithfulness we can persevere and hope that His beautiful plan will be fulfilled in our lives.

t: The One Who Calls You Is Faithful
v: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
b: This verse brings us great comfort and strength. When we know that God's call is based on His faithfulness, we can be full of confidence for the future. God not only calls us into His plan; He will also finish the work He has begun. His faithfulness is the greatest assurance on our life's journey, and however hard our situation, He will lead us to the end.

It is like an architect who has drawn up a grand blueprint and personally oversees every step of construction, making sure every detail is completed as planned. God is such an architect. He has designed a blueprint for our lives and personally leads us step by step toward the good He has ordained.

There was a sister named Zhang Xinyi who once felt she had lost her way in life. She had just graduated from university, could not decide which career path to take, and had experienced many setbacks and failures. She kept praying, but for a time no answer seemed to appear. Yet she always believed in God's call on her and that He is faithful and would accomplish His plan in her life. A few months later, Xinyi received a job offer that not only matched her field but also showed her a direction she could develop in the future. In the end she flourished in this job and witnessed God leading her step by step to fulfill His purpose.

Xinyi's testimony tells us that when we trust God's faithfulness, He will accomplish the work He has begun. Even when we cannot see the road ahead, God is arranging the best way out behind the scenes and leading us toward the abundant life He has ordained.
Dear family, let us remember that God is faithful. He has called us into His plan, and He will surely accomplish it. May we go forward in His faithfulness every day, full of faith and hope.

v: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

It is like an ancient lighthouse whose light still shines steadily over the channel even in the fiercest storm, giving a sense of direction to lost ships. In the same way, God's faithfulness is the lighthouse of our lives. Whatever hardship we go through, His faithfulness will always guide us to the land of peace.

There was a brother named Huang Zhiming who went through a very hard time in life. His business failed and his family fell into crisis, but Zhiming always believed that God's faithfulness would not change. Every morning he read Scripture and prayed, believing that God's mercy and faithfulness would lead him out of the darkness. In the end, Zhiming's business got started again, and his family relationships were restored through prayer and trust. Zhiming came to understand deeply that whatever we go through, God's faithfulness never wavers and His love is always with us.

Zhiming's story tells us that God's faithfulness is like the stars of heaven and does not change with time or circumstance. When we rely on His faithfulness, our lives are made firm and we no longer fear the coming of the storm.
Dear family, let us remember that God's faithfulness is established in the heavens and will never change. Whatever we go through, God's faithfulness is always our greatest support.

Dear family, let us remember that God's faithfulness is like a solid city wall, surrounding us at every moment. May we rely on His faithfulness every day, fear no storm, and enjoy His protection and peace.

As time passed, Jiali's family was gradually reconciled and their finances slowly improved, which let her understand more deeply the limitlessness and greatness of God's faithfulness.

In the same way, God's faithfulness and righteousness hold us firmly in His promises, and whatever challenge we face, we can keep walking, relying on this solid support.

In the end she chose to trust God's guidance and felt God's blessing and leading in her new position.

Wenhui's experience tells us that when we face choices or difficulty, God's faithfulness and righteousness become our firm support. He will not let us lose our way, but in every decision gives us enough strength and wisdom.

Draw up a "faithful life planner" for yourself, listing the commitments you must complete each day and checking daily whether you completed them faithfully. This helps you form a responsible attitude.
Dressing in Righteousness and Faithfulness
Each day choose simple but meaningful clothing as a symbol of your pursuit of righteousness and faithfulness. Your outward choices can also help form an inward attitude.
Faithfulness Support Group
Form a faithfulness support group with a few friends, regularly checking each other's honesty and faithfulness in life and supporting and encouraging one another to grow.
Shouldering Responsibility Faithfully

Be brave in taking on more responsibility in life, whether in family, work, or community, and show God's faithfulness by fulfilling your duties, so that the people around you benefit from your faithfulness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching us the importance of faithfulness. Please help us take honesty, righteousness, and faithfulness as our standard each day, so that our lives become Your witness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, led by God's faithfulness and righteousness, receive strength to pass through every challenge and witness His wonderful works. Amen!

v: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
b: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness is not only the foundation of our faith but also the nourishment of our lives. Just as food supplies our bodies, God's faithfulness supplies our souls. When we choose to trust the Lord and do good in this world, we are feeding on God's faithfulness, letting His truth nourish us and keep us steady on the road of faith.

It is like a farmer who feeds himself and his family on the grain from his field. He knows that if he works the land diligently, it will bring a harvest and supply what he needs. In the same way, if we keep relying on God's faithfulness, He will surely keep feeding us, filling and strengthening our spirits.

There was a brother named Huang Zhiqiang who experienced the power of this verse in a workplace crisis. At that time the company's performance was falling and the risk of layoffs was near, and Zhiqiang's heart was full of anxiety. But he did not lose faith. Each morning he entrusted his worries to God, asking for God's faithful provision and guidance. Zhiqiang firmly believed God would watch over him, and he chose to keep doing every task well at work and to show love and patience to his colleagues. In the end, not only did Zhiqiang not lose his job, but because of his persistent effort and good deeds he received an opportunity for promotion. All this made him deeply feel that God's faithfulness was like food, sustaining him every day.

Huang Zhiqiang's testimony tells us that God's faithfulness is the food of our lives. When we face difficulty or challenge, as long as we rely on Him, our souls are supplied and grow strong in hardship.

Dear family, let us remember that God's faithfulness is our most reliable supply, nourishing our spiritual life like food. May we feed on God's faithfulness every day and do good in this supply, to glorify His name.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness is the daily food and pillar of our lives. We can practice this truth through the following concrete actions:
a: Daily Spiritual Food Moment
Each morning or before bed, spend five minutes reading Scripture or meditating on God's faithfulness. This becomes your spiritual food for the day and brings you strength and direction.
Faithful Eating Habits
Pray silently before every meal, thanking God for faithfully providing food, and learn moderation and sharing, so that our eating becomes a witness reflecting God's faithfulness.
A Faithful Helping Plan
Each day choose one good deed to help someone around you, whether a neighbor, a colleague, or a stranger, so that your good deeds become an expression of God's faithfulness.
Gratitude and Provision
Whenever you feel God's faithful provision, remember to give Him thanks and share your blessing with those in need. This is one way of responding to God's faithfulness.
Faithful Management of Resources
Learn to be frugal and to manage faithfully the resources God has given. Such stewardship is not only wisdom but also shows our gratitude for God's faithful provision.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for supplying us with spiritual food every day. Your faithfulness is the foundation of our lives. Please help us feed on faithfulness each day, so that our good deeds and our stewardship reveal the richness of Your provision. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you receive God's faithful provision in your good deeds and trust each day, and grow strong in spirit under His feeding. Amen!

v: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.
b: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness and salvation should not stay only in our hearts but should be shared openly, so that more people may know how God's faithfulness works in our lives. When we testify to God's faithfulness, it is not only for ourselves but so that God's name may be glorified and others may be moved and changed by His faithfulness.

It is like a food critic who, when he tastes a delicious dish, shares the experience with more people so that everyone can enjoy it. In the same way, when we experience God's faithfulness and salvation, we should share that good experience and let more people taste God's goodness and love.

There was a sister named Li Meihui who once met a serious health crisis in her life, but through prayer and reliance on God, God wonderfully healed her. After she recovered she did not keep it quietly in her heart but actively shared her testimony in church, telling everyone how God's faithfulness helped her through the difficulty. Her testimony not only encouraged many people but also led some who had doubts about faith to reconsider the reality of God.
Meihui's testimony tells us that when we openly declare God's faithfulness and salvation, our lives are not only blessed by God but also become a channel of blessing for others.
Dear family, let us remember that God's faithfulness should not be hidden in our hearts but declared openly. May we boldly share God's faithfulness so that more people receive encouragement and hope.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us not to hide God's faithfulness but to share and testify to it boldly. We can practice this truth in the following ways:
a: Faithfulness Testimony Day

Set one day each week to share your testimony of experiencing God's faithfulness in the past week, whether through social media, family gatherings, or conversations with friends, spreading God's faithfulness widely.
Witnessing Through a Faithful Life
Testify to God not only in words but also in the conduct of daily life. When you meet a challenge, choose to hold to integrity, so that your conduct itself is a witness to God's faithfulness.
Faithfulness Testimony Partners

Pair up with family or friends to share each day's evidence of God's faithfulness and encourage each other to testify boldly to more people. Such sharing not only strengthens faith but also becomes a blessing to others.
Creative Testimony Events
Organize or join testimony events in a group or the community, such as a testimony evening, a sharing meal, or making a short testimony video, passing on God's faithfulness in creative ways.
Faithfulness Journal
Record each day the evidence of God's faithfulness you experience, and share these stories with others regularly, so that what you have written becomes encouragement and help to them.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your continuing faithfulness and salvation in our lives. Please give us courage and wisdom so that we no longer hide Your righteousness and faithfulness but boldly share them, giving a good witness for You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you be a witness to God's faithfulness every day and influence the lives of others through your testimony. Amen!

v: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
b: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness deserves our loud praise, because His wonders and salvation in our lives are beyond what we can imagine. When we praise God's faithfulness in the assembly, we are not only thanking Him for His works but also proclaiming His greatness, so that more people may hear of God's wondrous deeds.

It is like a musician playing the most beautiful movement in a concert hall, drawing everyone's gaze. In the same way, our praise of God's faithfulness should be like that lovely melody, drawing the attention of others and inviting everyone to join in praising God's greatness.

There was a sister named Zhang Yawen who always loved to praise God's faithfulness with songs. Whenever the church held a praise gathering, she took part eagerly, leading the congregation to sing God's name together. Once she went through a hard test, facing the pressure of a major decision. Yet during that time Yawen kept attending the praise gatherings and faced life's challenges with a heart of praise. Later she witnessed how God worked wonders in her difficulty and helped her through.
Yawen's experience tells us that whatever our situation, when we praise God's faithfulness with a heart of praise, God's grace and strength come to us and help us face every challenge.
Dear family, let us remember that we should keep praising God's faithfulness, whether in the assembly or in our daily lives, letting His faithfulness be the most beautiful melody of our lives.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us to praise His faithfulness in the assembly of God's people and to let our lives reflect our praise of Him. We can practice this truth in the following ways:
a: Praise and Thanksgiving Gathering

Regularly hold praise and thanksgiving gatherings at home or in a group, inviting everyone to share the wonderful works of God they have experienced and to praise His faithfulness in worship and prayer.
Praise Wall

Praise Through Music
Learn to praise God's faithfulness through songs or music. You can take part in or organize worship events regularly and invite friends to lift up God's name together in song.
Write a Hymn of Praise
Write songs or poems of praise to God in your own unique way, whether a short poem, a prayer, or a story, recording God's faithfulness and sharing it with more people.
Daily Praise
At the beginning or end of each day, take a moment to quiet your heart, meditate on God's faithfulness, and offer Him praise. This will become a steady strength in your spiritual life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for filling our lives with faithfulness. Please help us see Your works every day and praise Your wonders loudly in the assembly, so that Your faithfulness fills our praise. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you face life with a heart of praise every day and experience God's wonderful works as you extol His faithfulness. Amen!

v: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
b: This verse tells us that we should proclaim God's lovingkindness and faithfulness at every moment. Whether morning or night, God's faithfulness is always with us, and His lovingkindness has never left us. When we proclaim God's faithfulness in all kinds of ways, we are not only praising Him but also witnessing to His works, and this is a beautiful thing.

It is like a musician who practices every morning and night, persevering until he becomes an excellent musician. In the same way, we should proclaim God's faithfulness morning and evening without ceasing. This not only makes our own faith firmer but also lets the people around us feel God's greatness.

There was a brother named Li Guohua whose first act every morning when he woke was to thank God for His lovingkindness, and at night before sleep he would reflect on the day's experiences and praise God's faithfulness. This habit let him feel God's presence whatever difficulty he met. His family and work were blessed because of this habit, and his testimony influenced many brothers and sisters, encouraging them to form habits of praise and thanksgiving.

Guohua's testimony tells us that when we proclaim God's faithfulness in daily life, our lives are filled with His lovingkindness and grace, and our lives become richer through this perseverance in faith.
Dear family, let us remember that whether morning or night, we should proclaim God's faithfulness, letting His lovingkindness and faithfulness be the main melody of our lives.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us to proclaim God's lovingkindness and faithfulness at all times and to worship Him with music. We can practice this in the following concrete ways:

Choose a time each day, morning or night, to play worship music or play an instrument yourself, focusing on God's lovingkindness and faithfulness and letting music be a comfort to your soul.

If you are interested in learning an instrument, you can dedicate this skill to God and use it to play worship music, whether for family worship or group gatherings, offering your musical skill to God.
Sharing Music
Each week choose a hymn about God's faithfulness, share it with friends or family, and talk about how it has encouraged you. Such sharing lets God's faithfulness be proclaimed more widely.
Devotional Music Time
Add a music element to every devotional time, whether listening to hymns or quietly playing an instrument, to deepen your connection with God and your meditation.
Family Worship Time
Set a fixed time each week for music worship with your family, whether singing hymns or playing instruments, expressing your gratitude and praise for God's faithfulness through music.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for filling our lives with lovingkindness and faithfulness. Please help us worship You every day with music, songs, and instruments, and proclaim Your wonderful works. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you proclaim God's faithfulness with a thankful heart every morning and night, and experience His abundant blessing in the process. Amen!

t: Telling of God's Faithfulness with the Mouth
v: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
b: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness is endless, and we should not only experience it ourselves but also proclaim it to all generations. Our mouths are used not only to express our own thoughts but also as instruments to proclaim God's wondrous works. Every testimony and every sharing of ours is a way of telling God's faithfulness with our lives, so that His name is honored and His faithfulness becomes the support of people in every generation.

It is like a traditional craftsman who not only carries on his craft with care but also teaches it freely, passing the precious skill to later generations so that it does not vanish with time. In the same way, we should use our own voices to pass God's faithfulness and love on to the next generation, so that they too may know how wonderfully God works and receive this faith and blessing from one generation to the next.

There was a brother named Chen Zhiwen who was a zealous evangelist. At every small-group meeting and church event he was glad to share what God had done in his life. Whether how God led him through hard days or how he was blessed by trusting God, Zhiwen told these testimonies with care. These stories not only encouraged brothers and sisters of his own age but also deeply influenced the younger generation. Once his sharing moved a young sister so much that she began to take her faith seriously again and resolved to follow Jesus more deeply. Zhiwen's spoken testimony became a channel for spreading God's faithfulness, letting more people feel God's love and faithfulness through his sharing.

Zhiwen's story tells us that when we proclaim God's faithfulness with our mouths, our lives are not only blessed ourselves but become vessels of blessing for others. God's faithfulness is passed on through our testimony, so that more people see God's wondrous works in our sharing.

Dear family, let us remember that we have a responsibility to proclaim God's faithfulness to later generations, so that His works are remembered from generation to generation. Whatever happens in our lives, as long as we keep singing of God's lovingkindness and telling of His faithfulness, our lives will keep witnessing to His glory.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that singing of God's lovingkindness and faithfulness should not stay only in our hearts but be spread widely through our words, actions, and music. We can put this into practice through the following creative ways:
a: Write a Hymn
Try writing your own worship song with a simple melody, with words about your experience of God's faithfulness or your thanks, and share it with friends or church.
Daily Thanksgiving Voice Message

Each day record a short voice message sharing the faithfulness of God you experienced that day, whether on the commute or at home, and send it to friends or family. This not only encourages others but deepens your own faith.
A Talk on God's Faithfulness

At a church or community gathering, take the initiative to arrange a talk on faithfulness, telling of the moments you saw God's faithfulness in your life, and encourage everyone to witness to God's lovingkindness together.
Parent-Child Singing Time
If you have children, set a "singing time" each morning or evening to sing hymns with them, letting them learn from childhood to sing of God's faithfulness.
Faithfulness Lyrics Notebook
Write down each day the faithfulness of God you experience, expressing it in words or song, and gather these testimonies into a small notebook to share regularly with family or friends.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your abundant lovingkindness and faithfulness. May we, with songs, words, and actions, always proclaim Your wondrous works and pass this beautiful testimony on to all generations. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you proclaim God's faithfulness by word of mouth every day, become a witness of God's love, and let His wondrous works endure to all generations. Amen!

v: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?
b: This verse reminds us that while we still have the breath of life, we should actively proclaim God's lovingkindness and faithfulness. In the grave one can no longer tell of God's works, so in our limited lives we should seize every opportunity to witness for the Lord and proclaim His faithfulness. The time and resources God has given us are limited, and we should use them well, so that His name is lifted high while we live.

It is like a runner who, while he still has strength, must run with all his might in order to win honor in the race. If he slows down or wastes time, he cannot recover once his strength is spent. In the same way, in our spiritual race we should keep telling of God's faithfulness while there is still opportunity, so that we can complete the mission God has entrusted to us.

There was a brother named Zhang Zhiqiang who, in his later years, often thought about the value and meaning of his life. He realized that before his life came to its end there was still much he could do for the Lord. So he decided to take a more active part in church ministry and to share with family and friends God's faithful works throughout his life. By sharing his journey of faith, Zhiqiang led many relatives and friends to Christ and set a spiritual example for the younger generation. He often told people, "As long as I have breath, I will tell of God's faithfulness." His testimony became a great encouragement in the church.

Zhiqiang's testimony tells us that although our lives are limited, God's faithfulness is limitless. We should seize every opportunity to tell others of God's faithfulness, so that more people receive salvation and hope.

Dear family, let us remember that life is short, but God's faithfulness lasts forever. May we, while we still have breath, devote ourselves to telling of His faithfulness, so that our lives become a witness to His beautiful works.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us not to wait until the end of life to tell of God's faithfulness, but to live out a testimony every day and spread God's faithfulness in every area of life. We can put it into practice like this:
a: Daily Faithfulness Sharing
Whether at home, at work, or with friends, deliberately share one thing about God's faithfulness. This can encourage others to begin noticing God's works too.
Faithfulness Tagging Challenge

Whenever you experience God's faithfulness, mark it on your calendar right away, and review these moments each week, giving thanks and sharing them with others. You will see God's faithfulness running through every day.
Testimony Sharing Group

Start a testimony-sharing group, gathering regularly with friends from church or community, dedicated to sharing how each of you has experienced God's faithfulness, and encourage others to join in such sharing.
Faithfulness Heritage Project
If you have children or family, set up a "heritage of faithfulness" project, recording the stories of God's faithfulness experienced in your family. This will become your family's spiritual treasure.
An Attitude of Sharing at Any Time

Cultivate an attitude of sharing faithfulness stories at any time, whether in an ordinary moment of life or when you meet someone who needs encouragement, and be willing to speak freely of God's faithfulness in your life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for letting us witness to Your faithfulness while we live. May we miss no opportunity to share this testimony with everyone, and let Your great works fill our lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you tell of God's faithfulness with a positive attitude every day, and experience His abundant grace in the process. Amen!

v: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
b: This verse reminds us that God's word is certain and trustworthy, with no ambiguity. Here Paul stresses that the message he proclaimed rests entirely on God's faithfulness, a firm foundation worth relying on. When we proclaim God's word, we rely on God's faithfulness, not on human wisdom or ability. God's faithfulness is not only His attribute but also the guarantee of our proclaiming the truth.

It is like an architect who must rely on a solid foundation in order to build a sturdy house. In the same way, if what we preach is based on God's faithfulness, it is built on firm ground and can withstand the test of wind and rain.

There was a sister named Li Meifang who often met questions and challenges when sharing the gospel. But she never wavered, because she knew that what she preached was God's word, and God is faithful. Once a friend challenged her, "How can you be sure that what you believe is the truth?" Meifang answered calmly, "Because I rely on the faithful God, and His word never changes." As time passed, the friend was gradually moved by her confidence and testimony and in the end decided to believe in the Lord as well.
Meifang's testimony tells us that when we proclaim His word on the strength of the faithful God, we need not doubt or shrink back, because what we rely on is the unchanging truth.
Dear family, let us remember that God's word is based on His faithfulness, and the gospel we preach has a firm foundation. May we stand boldly on God's faithfulness and proclaim this truth.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that when we tell of God's faithfulness, we must make sure what we say is true and hold to an honest, unfalsified testimony. We can put it into practice like this:
a: Honest Sharing Challenge

Commit that whenever you share a spiritual experience with someone, you will hold to honesty and no falsehood, making sure that what you testify is exactly what you truly experienced of God's work. Such testimony will have more power.
True Testimony Plan

Start a "true testimony journal." Whenever you experience God's work, record it honestly and share it regularly with the church or friends. This journal will become a witness to the growth of your faith.
Faithfulness Heritage Gathering
Hold a "faithfulness heritage gathering," inviting family and friends to share God's true works with one another, and encourage everyone to commit to being completely true in their sharing.
A Life of Honest Worship
In every day of life, in your dealings with God and with people, keep an honest heart. This not only witnesses to God's faithfulness but lets your own life testify to God's real presence.
A Declaration of Faithfulness

Each morning after you get up, declare to yourself, "I will honestly witness to God's faithfulness." Then you will pay closer attention at every moment of life to whether your words and conduct are true.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, please help us hold to truth and honesty when we share Your faithfulness, so that our testimony becomes a powerful tool that brings encouragement and edification to more people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, each time you proclaim God's word, build on the faithful God and, with assurance and confidence, witness to His wonderful works. Amen!

v: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
b: This verse reveals to us that God's faithfulness and lovingkindness will be with us forever. When God promises to walk with us, we are never alone. Whatever challenge or hardship we go through, His faithfulness is our strongest support. God not only gives His lovingkindness but also guarantees that His faithfulness will be our shield and support, so that we can hold our heads high in difficulty, knowing that His promise never fails.

It is like a faithful friend who, however hard your situation, stays by your side and offers help and encouragement. In the same way, God's faithfulness and lovingkindness will never leave us. He will support us when we need Him most, so that we can still stand firm in the challenge.

There was a brother named Lin Weiqiang whose life was full of all kinds of challenges. Once his company was close to collapse because of an economic crisis, and many employees left one after another. Facing this predicament, Weiqiang did not know what to do, but he firmly believed that God's faithfulness and lovingkindness would be with him. He began to pray more earnestly, seeking God's guidance. Although the situation was very hard for a time, he kept holding on in his heart to God's promise and relied on His grace at every step. In the end his company not only came out of the crisis but became stronger because of it, and in the process he experienced God's wonderful keeping and provision.

Weiqiang's testimony shows us that when we face difficulty and challenge, we can rely on God's faithfulness with confidence. Whatever changes in our surroundings, God's lovingkindness and faithfulness never change. He will lead us through the storm, and at every peak and valley of our lives His name will be lifted high.

Dear family, let us remember that however rough the road of our lives, God's faithfulness and lovingkindness are always with us. We can rely on Him completely, because He is our unchanging support. May we see God's wonderful works in every challenge and find firmness and keeping in His name.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God's faithfulness and lovingkindness will accompany us all our lives, and we should respond to God's faithfulness with action and give the glory to Him. We can put it into practice like this:
a: Walking-with-Faithfulness Plan

After praying each morning, remind yourself that God's faithfulness and lovingkindness will walk with you today, and pass this confidence on to the people around you, whether through a greeting or by helping with their needs.
Daily Grace Journal
At the end of each day, record how God showed His faithfulness and lovingkindness that day, and respond to God with a thankful heart.
Sharing Blessings of Faithfulness

Make "faithfulness blessing cards" for friends or colleagues, writing in them testimonies of God's faithfulness in your life along with a prayer for them. This will be a blessing to their spiritual lives.
Faithfulness Review Gathering
Each month, hold a "faithfulness review" with family or friends, sharing how God showed His faithfulness during that time, and give thanks and pray together.
Faithful Action Challenge
Make a faithful commitment in life and keep it to the end. It can be a promise to family or friends, so that your actions too witness to God's faithfulness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for accompanying us with faithfulness and lovingkindness. Please help us remember Your grace every day and respond to You with our conduct, so that Your name is lifted high through our testimony. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you deeply experience the presence of God's faithfulness in daily life and walk in His grace, looking to His help whatever you face. Amen!

v: Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
b: This verse lets us see that God's faithfulness and righteousness are what we rely on when we make our requests. When we face difficulty and cry out to God, we can be sure He will answer, because He is the faithful God. Our prayer is not based on our own ability or worthiness but on God's faithfulness and righteousness. This reliance lets us pray with confidence, knowing He will respond to our supplication according to His promise.

It is like a just judge whose verdicts always follow truth and law without favoritism. In the same way, when God answers our prayers, it is always according to His faithfulness and righteousness, unaffected by any outside factor. Every decision of His comes from His truth and love, and this lets us hand all our difficulties into His hands with peace of mind.

There was a sister named Li Fang who had prayed for years for the salvation of her family without seeing a result. Even so, she did not give up praying but trusted God's faithfulness all the more firmly. She believed God would answer her request in His own time. Many years later, her family accepted the gospel through an unexpected opportunity, and their lives changed greatly. Li Fang's prayer was finally answered by God's faithfulness, and she saw with her own eyes the work of God's righteousness and faithfulness.
Li Fang's story tells us that however long our prayer has waited, God's faithfulness does not change. He will respond to us in His own time and way, and His answer will surely be the best for us.

Dear family, let us remember that our requests are not in vain, because God is faithful and righteous. When we cry out to Him in faith, He will surely answer us in His faithfulness. May we rely on His faithfulness in every prayer and wait with full confidence for His promise to be fulfilled.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that God hears our prayers according to His faithfulness and righteousness, and we can show our trust in God through petition and action. We can put it into practice like this:
a: Daily Meditation and Prayer
Set aside time each morning or evening to meditate quietly on God's faithfulness, and bring your heart's requests in prayer, trusting that He will answer you in faithfulness and righteousness.
Intercede for Others

Among family, friends, or a church group, take the initiative to ask about their needs and pray for them, and record these faithful intercessions in a notebook, so that when God answers you can thank Him for His faithfulness together.
A Prayer-Time Reminder
Set a daily reminder on your phone so that at each prayer you focus on God's faithfulness and entrust your worries to Him.
Responding to Faithfulness
When you experience God answering your request in faithfulness and righteousness, share the testimony with others to encourage their growth in faith.
A Faith Prayer Group
Form a group dedicated to sharing prayer testimonies, sharing with friends from church or community how you have each experienced God's faithful answers, and encouraging one another's faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for hearing our prayers according to Your faithfulness and righteousness. Please help us rely on You more each day and share the grace we experience with others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you feel God's faithful answer in every prayer and find peace and joy in His righteousness. Amen!

v: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
b: This verse reminds us that the Holy Spirit works in our hearts to make us bear spiritual fruit, and one important fruit is faithfulness. Faithfulness means our loyalty and reliability toward God and others. In any situation we should keep the attitude of keeping our promises. This is not only our response to God but also the character we should show in our dealings with others.

Faithfulness is like a great tree that, after a long time of cultivation, finally bears abundant fruit. In the same way, our faithfulness is the result of the Holy Spirit working in our hearts for a long time. When we are willing to obey the Spirit's guidance, this character of faithfulness will naturally appear in our lives and become the foundation of our dealings with God and others.

There was a brother named Zhang Wenhua who was always known at work for his honesty and trustworthiness. Whatever difficulty or pressure he met, he always held to his commitments to clients and colleagues and never compromised easily. Once the company met a major challenge and many chose to give up, but Wenhua persisted in finishing his work and helped the company through the crisis. His faithfulness and loyalty won the praise of company management and also influenced the colleagues around him, letting them see the importance of honesty and trustworthiness.

Wenhua's story tells us that when we let the Holy Spirit work in our hearts, the fruit of faithfulness will be borne in our lives, becoming an example for others to learn from and glorifying God's name.

Dear family, let us remember that faithfulness is fruit borne by the Holy Spirit. When we are willing to obey God's leading, He will surely make our lives bear abundant fruit and become a blessing to others.
ah: Peace to you, dear family. Let us follow together today's Soul Snack action guide: This verse reminds us that faithfulness is one of the fruits of the Spirit. We need to walk with the Holy Spirit to bear such beautiful fruit and live out a testimony of faithfulness in daily life. We can put it into practice like this:
a: Faithful Commitment Challenge

Each morning make one faithful commitment, for example to finish a certain task today or to keep a promise to someone on time, and make sure the commitment is carried out. This will gradually build habits of faithfulness in your life.
Faithfulness in Devotional Time
However busy your work, set a fixed devotional time for yourself and keep meeting God daily. This not only steadies your own faith but is also a response to God's faithfulness.
Mutual Faithfulness Support
Form a group in which everyone commits to one thing and carries it out within a week, then shares how it went. This deepens mutual trust and a sense of responsibility.
Faithful Punctuality
Each day at work, at home, and at church, form a habit of being on time for appointments and gatherings. This fills your relationships with trust and makes you an example of faithfulness.
Gifts of the Fruit of Faithfulness

Make "fruit of faithfulness" cards, writing down each testimony of faithfulness you experience, and give the cards to family or friends so they can feel God's work in your life and be encouraged to pursue such faithfulness too.

dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you bear the fruit of faithfulness in your life every day, become a faithful servant God delights in, and witness His wonderful works. Amen!
